summary.contributions: 论文声称的主要贡献包括：一是带宽自适应执行，把有限的边缘带宽从固定瓶颈变为运行时调度信号，预填充阶段用全层双缓冲把专家搬运隐藏在计算之后，解码阶段用 q* 策略把每步缓存未命中在 PCIe 传输与 CPU 直接执行之间分配；二是语义感知缓存，在预填充阶段把循环状态检查点锚定在思考段、工具调用等语义边界，使上下文编辑后只需重算新增后缀，在解码阶段用共享 LRU 专家缓存利用 token 间路由局部性；三是弹性边缘资源管理，可在调度安全点动态调整并重建 GPU 专家缓存，且通过直接按最终主机布局加载专家来缩短启动时间。
summary.method: FreeToken 采用两级专家内存层次：CPU 常驻专家池保存完整路由专家权重并作为唯一真值来源，非专家权重常驻 GPU，剩余显存构成所有 MoE 层共享的弹性专家缓存，槽位以逻辑（层，专家）标识。预填充阶段对整层专家做双缓冲流水加载，并用语义感知状态缓存保存循环状态检查点；解码阶段先用共享 LRU 专家缓存命中大部分路由访问，剩余未命中按 q*≈m·B_P/B_H 的闭式比例在 PCIe 缓存填充与 CPU 原地执行之间划分，其中 B_P 与 B_H 为部署机器上实测的专家传输带宽与主机侧专家处理带宽，CPU 与 GPU 的部分输出精确合并。实现上把路由相关控制放在 GPU 侧，使用 CUDA Graph 兼容的 LRU 缓存、设备端缓存控制内核、持久 C++ CPU 工作线程池，以及 FTW 权重格式来加速加载。
summary.results: 论文节选给出的实验结论包括：在 RTX 5090 上，FreeToken 在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上维持 77–83 tok/s，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 上维持 22–25 tok/s，比最强基线在各工作负载上高 1.5–2.3 倍；解码速率在 Agent 工作负载下保持在单轮设置的 12% 以内，而部分基线明显退化；最差 TTFT 在所有工作负载中低于 44 秒，而每个基线至少在一个设置中超过 150 秒。跨五台消费级系统解码吞吐提升 1.3–2.1 倍；8GB RTX 4060 笔记本上以 39.3 tok/s 服务 35B 模型；32GB 游戏台式机上交互式服务 284B 模型；单张 RTX PRO 6000 工作站 GPU 上以 14.9 tok/s 服务 753B GLM-5.2，约为 llama.cpp 的 2.0 倍。预填充双缓冲使 8192 token 分块在 1.19–1.22 秒完成，关闭第二缓冲在 4k、8k、16k token 时分别损失 19%、25%、26% 吞吐。在相同缓存容量下，FreeToken 全局 LRU 的解码期专家读取未命中率为 16% 和 39%，低于 KTransformers 的 41% 和 59% 以及 llama.cpp 的 62% 和 89%。
summary.limitations: 论文节选未提供独立的局限性章节，摘要未提供，需查看全文。可注意到的边界包括：部分实验在租用服务器上通过限制 CPU 线程数来模拟边缘主机带宽；某些基线在部分配置下无法服务；FreeToken 在 Qwen3.6×W3 的平均 TTFT 上并非最低；在无法固定或注册 DMA 的平台上会退化为纯 CPU MoE 后端，牺牲峰值传输带宽。这些是否被作者列为局限，需查看全文确认。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化、长程 Agent 多步工具调用量化、KV cache 的关系如下：量化方面，论文直接使用 MXFP4、NVFP4 等量化专家权重部署，并强调在相同权重格式下与基线对比，但论文本身不是量化算法研究，而是量化模型的服务系统。长程 Agent 与多步工具调用方面，论文直接以真实编码与工具调用 Agent 工作负载为评测对象，针对工具调用导致的频繁重预填充、上下文编辑与跨轮状态复用设计语义锚点与循环状态检查点，属于直接相关的 Agent 服务系统工作，但其量化相关结论主要是使用量化权重而非研究量化对 Agent 精度的影响。KV cache 方面，论文用基数前缀树管理全注意力 KV 缓存，并把循环状态检查点作为额外前缀资源，在弹性显存预算下与专家缓存共享 GPU 内存；论文未提出新的 KV 量化方法，KV cache 主要作为内存管理与前缀复用对象出现。

papers.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
papers.abstract: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that learns to select query-relevant images through visual scanning and retrieve textual content only where needed, combining the efficiency of visual compression with the precision of text-based reasoning. Through supervised fine-tuning on tool-interaction trajectories, SEER learns adaptive tool invocation for selection and retrieval. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that SEER improves extraction precision through selective text retrieval while retaining average prompt-token savings relative to full-text baselines. On LongBench, SEER achieves 51.11% average accuracy, outperforming the visual-text baseline Glyph-9B by 2.33 points and Qwen3-8B by 3.49 points. Code can be accessed at https://github.com/jiaweixu98/SEER

summary.title_zh: Seer：通过选择性视觉-文本压缩实现长上下文推理
summary.tldr: 论文提出 Seer 框架，在视觉-文本压缩的基础上，让模型先通过视觉扫描选出与查询相关的图像页，再确定性地检索这些页的原始文本，最后结合视觉上下文与检索文本进行推理。基于 Glyph-9B 做监督微调，在 LongBench 上取得 51.11% 平均准确率，比 Glyph-9B 高 2.33 分，但提示词压缩率从 3.14 倍降至 1.28 倍，且延迟高于全文本推理。
summary.contributions: 提出 Seer 框架，将视觉-文本压缩与选择性工具调用结合，只对与推理最相关的图像检索文本；提出选择-检索-推理三阶段推理流程及联合优化选择与推理能力的训练策略；在 LongBench 上报告 51.11% 平均准确率，比 Glyph-9B 高 2.33 分，在抽取密集型任务上提升明显（Qasper +8.75，MultiFieldQA-Zh +19.17），并称比 Qwen3-8B 高 3.49 分。
summary.method: 给定文本上下文渲染为图像序列，模型分三阶段：阶段一视觉选择，模型输出相关图像索引集合；阶段二文本检索，由于渲染过程保留了源文本，按索引做确定性查找而非 OCR；阶段三推理，模型在全部图像加检索文本上生成思维链与答案，整体按 ReAct 式 Thought-Action-Observation 工具调用实现。训练用监督微调，初始化自 Glyph-9B，训练数据由 Qwen3.5-9B 做页面相关性标注、Qwen3-32B 生成推理链并只保留答对的样本，损失对系统提供的观察 token 做掩码，仅监督模型生成内容。
summary.results: LongBench 上 Seer 平均 51.11%，Glyph-9B 为 48.78%，Qwen3-8B 为 47.62%；单文档 QA 中 Qasper 从 38.99 升至 47.74，NarrativeQA 从 21.83 升至 26.05，多文档 QA 中 HotpotQA 从 56.42 升至 60.22；中文任务 MultiFieldQA-Zh +19.17、PassageRetrieval-Zh +6.00、VCSUM +1.92。Token 方面，GLM-4-9B-Chat-1M 平均提示词 10175.8，Glyph-9B 为 3522.5（3.14 倍压缩），Seer 为 7623.8（1.28 倍压缩）。消融显示去掉检索降至 43.00，纯视觉为 48.78，同数据但去掉机制的对照为 45.20。平均每查询选择 1.59 张有效图像，中位数 1，少于 1% 的查询选择超过三张。
summary.limitations: 选择作为部署接口不够稳健，模型偶尔输出越界页索引，论文直接丢弃而非纠正；效率收益比压缩率暗示的更窄，21 个任务中有 7 个 Seer 的提示词比全文本更大，节省体现在提示词与 KV cache 占用而非速度，batch size 1 时中位端到端延迟 5.47 秒，而全文本为 1.07 秒；准确率提升仅针对证据集中在少数页面的问题，证据分散时收益变薄，且训练数据因答案条件过滤而低估该情形；Seer 仅针对渲染长文档的问答，未在自然图像、图表或 OCR 基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 论文与大模型量化没有直接关系，未涉及权重量化、激活量化或 KV cache 量化方法。与长程 Agent / 多步工具调用量化的关系是：Seer 采用 ReAct 式工具调用轨迹（选择与检索两个工具），属于多步工具调用范式的实例，但论文没有做 Agent 基准实验，也没有量化 Agent 场景下的工具调用开销，相关 Agent 应用属于推测而非论文实验结论。与 KV cache 的关系是：论文明确将效率收益限定在提示词与 KV cache 占用层面，视觉-文本压缩通过减少提示词 token 降低 KV cache 足迹，但未对 KV cache 本身做压缩或量化，也未报告 KV cache 的实测数值。

papers.title: Noesis: Bidirectional Graph-RAG with Adaptive Parallelism and Cross-Knowledge-Base Semantic Discovery
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation over knowledge graphs (Graph-RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for grounding large language models in domain-specific corpora. However, existing systems face persistent limitations: (1) static chunking fragments long documents, losing cross-section semantic connections; (2) ingestion pipelines do not scale adaptively; and (3) multi-domain deployments require either a monolithic knowledge base that dilutes retrieval precision or manual user routing. We present Noesis, a decoupled Graph-RAG architecture addressing these limitations through four algorithms: (a) Bidirectional Graph Traversal with a Graph-Feedback Context Resolver simulating human reading with degrading memory; (b) an AIMD Concurrency Controller adapted from TCP congestion control, achieving 23x speedup with zero OOM events; (c) Moesis, domain-aware selective quantization for MoE models achieving 6.3x speedup on 12 GB consumer GPUs; and (d) Mesh, cross-KB semantic routing with runtime structural discovery enabling small on-premises models to perform multi-hop cross-domain reasoning. On HotpotQA (1,000 questions), Noesis achieves 59.5 EM / 74.7 F1, surpassing GraphRAG by +27.8 EM while using a 35B on-premises model for graph construction rather than GPT-4o. Source text verification on a 193-page document confirms 90% precision on long-range causal edges inaccessible to chunk-independent extraction.

summary.title_zh: Noēsis：具备自适应并行与跨知识库语义发现能力的双向图检索增强生成系统
summary.tldr: 本文提出 Noēsis，一个解耦式 Graph-RAG 架构，包含四个算法组件：带图反馈上下文解析器的双向图遍历、借鉴 TCP 拥塞控制的 AIMD 并发控制器、面向 MoE 模型的领域感知选择性量化管线 Moēsis，以及跨知识库语义路由与运行时结构发现系统 Mesh。论文报告在真实工作负载上的实测结果，包括 13.4MB 语料 1 分 6 秒完成摄取（对比顺序处理约 25 分钟）、消费级 GPU 上提示处理 6.3 倍加速、跨知识库路由延迟低于 2 毫秒，并在 HotpotQA 上取得 59.5 EM / 74.7 F1。
summary.contributions: 论文声称的四项贡献为：一，带前向图反馈上下文解析（n-gram 评分加近因衰减）与后向基于度数的重连的双向图遍历算法；二，将 TCP 拥塞控制原理迁移到 RAG 流水线编排、并以 Redis 持久化状态的 AIMD 并发控制器；三，Moēsis，对混合专家模型进行自动领域画像、分类与选择性量化并支持运行时再适配；四，Mesh，基于分层指纹的跨知识库路由，具备运行时结构发现与自适应 Natural Break 阈值。
summary.method: 系统为解耦架构，由 Cortex（推理引擎）、Neuron（图抽取库）、Synapsis（编排层）、Retina（音视频摄取）与 Mesh（跨知识库路由）五个组件通过 REST 与 Redis 消息队列通信。双向图遍历在前向阶段按语义边界切分文档，并用图反馈上下文解析器按相关性与近因评分选择已抽取节点作为下一片段的上下文；后向阶段对低度数的早期节点尝试与语义相关的后期节点重连。并发控制采用 AIMD：连续成功后并发数加一，连续失败后减半，状态经 Redis 持久化以支持崩溃恢复。Moēsis 分三级：CPU 推理做领域画像记录每层每专家激活频率，按层分类后热层用 6 比特、冷层用 2 比特量化，并采用只提升不降级的 GPU 放置策略，领域变化时从保留的全精度模型重新量化。Mesh 用社区加权平均嵌入生成知识库指纹，按余弦相似度、社区语义重叠、词面标签匹配三级策略路由，并用自适应 Natural Break 阈值在跨库块与节点间发现涌现连接。
summary.results: 论文报告的实测结果包括：多语言知识库（5 份 PDF）上单遍无反馈基线为 29 节点、36 边、4 社区，双向遍历为 253 节点、257 边、179 交叉链接、12 社区，完整抽取运行为 834 节点、2301 边、46 社区；193 页心理学书籍上后向遍历产生 928 条文档内因果边，GPT-4o 温度 0 对 50 条随机抽样因果边的评判在无书籍上下文时为 72% 精度，提供领域上下文后为 84%，对照原文验证后为 90%，五条错误边包含两条因果方向颠倒与三条无支撑关系，另一份俄语临床营养方案文档为无上下文 48%、领域上下文 74%；3 份 PDF 共 13.4MB 在自适应并行下 1 分 6 秒完成，对比顺序约 25 分钟，约 23 倍加速，未观察到 OOM；Moēsis 在 RTX 4080 笔记本 12GB 上提示处理从 22 提升到 139 t/s（6.3 倍），token 生成从 7.8 提升到 12.3 t/s（1.6 倍），6GB 压力测试下稳定运行 160 分钟以上无崩溃，而无 Moēsis 时立即 OOM；HotpotQA 干扰集 1000 题上 Noēsis 加 GPT-4o 为 59.50 EM / 74.74 F1，超过 GraphRAG 的 31.70 EM / 42.74 F1 与 BGE dense 加 GPT-4o 的 47.60 EM / 60.36 F1，低于 HopRAG 的 62.00 EM / 76.06 F1 与 StepChain 的 66.70 EM / 79.50 F1；消融显示 Noēsis 加 2.3B 参数 Gemma 4 E2B 为 47.20 EM / 60.30 F1，与 BGE dense 加 GPT-4o 的 47.60 EM / 60.36 F1 相当；检索预算从 k=10 提升到 k=20 仅增加 1.4 EM，达到 60.90 EM / 76.12 F1；55 个 Python 文件的代码语料生成 978 节点、3824 边的知识图。
summary.limitations: 论文自述的局限包括：23 倍与 6.3 倍等加速数值依赖具体硬件与语料，在不同语料或后端配置下绝对值会变化，尽管作者预期定性趋势成立；评估覆盖范围限于 HotpotQA 基准、两份不同语言与格式的长文档、一个软件代码库与三个跨领域知识库，更广泛的基准与领域评估有待补充；Mesh 跨知识库路由评估仅在三个领域知识库上以代表性查询演示机制，更广查询类型与知识库配置下的性能刻画仍属进行中工作。此外，摘要与节选未提供关于 Agent 场景、多步工具调用或 KV cache 的直接实验。
summary.relevance: 与大模型量化的关系：论文的 Moēsis 组件直接涉及量化，对混合专家模型按领域激活画像做逐层混合精度分配（热层 6 比特、冷层 2 比特），并采用只提升不降级的 GPU 放置策略与运行时再适配，属于面向 MoE 的领域感知选择性量化，与 DynaExq、MoPEQ、APEX、Mixture-Compressor 等工作并列比较。与长程 Agent 及多步工具调用量化的关系：论文未提供任何 Agent 或多步工具调用的实验，其多跳推理评估限于 HotpotQA 问答基准与代码理解查询，因此不能据此推断 Agent 场景下的量化效果；不过其 AIMD 并发控制器与 CONCUR、HiveMind 等面向 LLM Agent 工作负载的并发控制工作做了对比，且 Mesh 的跨知识库多跳发现机制在概念上与 Agent 的多步检索编排相关，但这属于论文未验证的推测。与 KV cache 的关系：论文未涉及 KV cache 的量化或管理；仅在相关工作部分提到 CONCUR 在单个服务引擎内于 GPU KV-cache 层面做准入控制，并指出 Noēsis 的控制器工作在文档级粒度而非 token、KV-cache 或 agent 粒度，因此本文与 KV cache 量化没有直接关系。

papers.title: KV-Rescue: Recovering Reasoning Language Model KV Eviction Loss via Stepwise Interleaving
papers.abstract: KV-cache eviction caps the memory cost of long reasoning traces but is inherently lossy because the model decodes from a partial view of its history. Under aggressive budgets, this not only lowers accuracy but can also cause runaway degeneration, where the model produces incoherent or repetitive tokens until reaching the length limit. We characterize much of this loss as an information gapf caused by missing context, rather than a capability gap caused by limited model capacity. An evicted 7B model and a full-context 1.5B model make complementary errors, and an oracle choice between their answers recovers 79% of the accuracy gap to the full-KV 7B model. Based on this observation, we propose KV-Rescue, a training-free inference framework that bridges the information gap introduced by KV eviction using a lightweight full-context helper. KV-Rescue interleaves reasoning steps from the two models into a shared trajectory. An online detector uses entropy and compressibility to terminate the generation of incoherent or repetitive base-model candidates early. Across five math benchmarks with Qwen2.5-Math 7B and 72B, KV-Rescue recovers an average of 87% of the accuracy lost to eviction at eviction budget B=64. A decode-cost analysis further shows that preventing runaway degeneration cuts base-model token generation by 43% on average.

summary.title_zh: KV-Rescue：通过逐步交错恢复推理语言模型的KV驱逐损失
summary.tldr: 论文提出KV-Rescue，一种免训练推理框架，用轻量级全上下文小模型与KV驱逐后的大模型逐步交错生成推理步骤，并由过程奖励模型选择最优步骤，从而弥补KV驱逐造成的信息缺口。在五个数学基准上，该方法平均恢复了87%因驱逐损失的准确率，并减少了43%的基座模型token生成。
summary.contributions: 1. 将KV驱逐损失识别为信息缺口而非能力缺口，并展示被驱逐的大模型与全上下文小模型会犯互补性错误。2. 提出KV-Rescue，一种免训练推理框架，在被驱逐基座模型与轻量级全上下文助手之间进行上下文互补推理，并配有在线退化检测器以提前终止退化的基座候选。3. 在五个数学基准、两种基座规模、两种驱逐方法上评估，显示恢复效果跨模型规模和驱逐策略持续存在，同时控制失控退化。
summary.method: KV-Rescue在每个推理步骤从被KV驱逐的基座模型和全上下文轻量助手分别采样候选步骤，使用过程奖励模型选择得分最高的步骤加入共享轨迹。在线退化检测器利用预测熵和gzip压缩比识别并提前终止不连贯生成或重复循环的基座候选。基座与助手步骤交错，两者保持各自不同的上下文视图。
summary.results: 在五个数学基准（MATH500、AIME24、AMC23、GSM8K、OlympiadBench）上，使用Qwen2.5-Math 7B和72B基座，在驱逐预算B=64时平均恢复87%的准确率损失。解码成本分析显示，防止失控退化使基座模型token生成平均减少43%。在batch 64时，KV-Rescue吞吐量是仅驱逐best-of-N的3.3倍，而全KV会内存溢出。消融实验显示交错显著降低轨迹退化，提前退出进一步减少token浪费。
summary.limitations: 论文针对两种离散退化模式（不连贯生成和重复循环），更渐进的失败如不必要地延长但连贯的推理不在研究范围内。摘要未提供，需查看全文以了解其他限制。
summary.relevance: 该论文直接研究KV cache驱逐（一种KV cache压缩方法）对推理语言模型的影响，并提出恢复方案。与大模型量化相关，因为KV cache量化是KV压缩的另一类方法，论文在引言中提及量化相关工作。与长程Agent/多步工具调用量化的关系：论文关注长推理轨迹中的KV驱逐，其逐步交错和在线退化检测机制可能对长程多步推理场景有参考价值，但论文未进行Agent或多步工具调用的实验，因此对Agent应用的适用性属于推测而非直接实验结论。与KV cache的关系是核心：论文分析KV驱逐导致的信息缺口，并提出通过全上下文助手交错来弥补该缺口。

papers.title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy
papers.abstract: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. At the kernel level, we implement a Lookup Table Building Approach with Scale Fusion to reduce floating-point arithmetic, featuring a Virtual Columnar Mapping that transforms irregular, sparse, and salient matrices into dense execution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate FluxBin achieves up to $5.92\times$ speedup and $10.19\times$ energy savings across diverse model architectures, delivering comparable accuracy to heavily fine-tuned methods. This effectively enables the deployment of 70B-scale models on one single A100 GPU with a $4\times$ memory reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/nicyyyy/FluxBin.

summary.title_zh: FluxBin：通过算法与内核协同实现灵活的基于查找表的超低位LLM推理
summary.tldr: FluxBin 是一种算法与 CUDA 内核协同设计的超低位 LLM 推理框架，采用解耦行列二值分解与 Hessian 引导的显著列混合基进行纯训练后量化，并配合基于查找表（LUT）的内核（含尺度融合与虚拟列映射）以避免反量化开销。论文摘要与节选声称在多种模型架构上实现最高 5.92 倍加速和 10.19 倍能耗节省，并可将 70B 规模模型部署在单张 A100 上。
summary.contributions: 提出纯训练后量化框架 FluxBin，包含解耦行列二值基与 Hessian 引导的混合基，兼顾硬件效率与有竞争力的精度；设计高度优化的基于 LUT 的 CUDA 内核，采用 LUT-BSF 与 VCM 策略，实现高保真混合精度并将二值基量化转化为实际推理优势；通过自定义 LUT 内核绕过反量化开销，将无乘法逻辑转化为实际加速，声称最高 5.92 倍加速与 10.19 倍能耗节省。
summary.method: 算法层面：提出解耦行列二值分解，在行缩放之外引入列缩放以捕捉各向异性权重分布，并通过交替最小化求闭式缩放因子；当基数量大于等于 2 时对所有 2 的 Kb 次方种符号组合做穷举以联合优化二值基；利用逆 Hessian 计算列级显著度分数，按组选取显著列构成掩码，在全局基近似之外对残差做显著列精修，形成混合基；整体为纯训练后量化，无微调或蒸馏。内核层面：LUT Building with Scale Fusion 将列缩放融合进查找表构建以消除关键路径上的浮点运算；Virtual Columnar Mapping 将逻辑稀疏的显著列重映射为物理稠密矩阵，使全局基与显著精修共用同一稠密 GEMV 内核；读取阶段直接流式读取压缩的 Uint32 权重，以位模式作为查找表地址获取预计算部分和，最后在寄存器中应用行缩放并归约写回。
summary.results: 在单张 NVIDIA A100 80GB 上评估，使用 CUDA graphs 消除框架开销。LLaMA-2-7B 上 FluxBin-2b-s16-g128 平均零样本准确率 59.15%，与重度微调的 QuIP#（59.41%）相当并优于 AQLM（58.64%）；7B 上达到 254.39 tokens/s，相对 FP16 基线加速 5.92 倍；70B 上吞吐比 QuIP# 高 3.25 倍；解码阶段在 BS=1 时加速 6.3 至 6.6 倍；平均功耗从约 225W 降至约 115W（13B），总能耗降低 10.19 倍；实现最高 4 倍内存压缩，使 LLaMA-2-70B 可在单张 A100 上运行而 FP16 基线出现 OOM。消融显示：去掉列缩放使 Wiki PPL 从 8.20 升至 8.96，随机替代显著度搜索导致 PPL 升至 26.02，仅用全局基 PPL 升至 13.71；禁用 VCM 导致速度下降 18%、内存上升 33%。
summary.limitations: 作者列出两点：一是 LUT 内核依赖片上共享内存缓存，LUT 存储随子向量大小呈指数增长、随每块批大小线性增长，在共享内存有限的硬件上可能需要减小 μ 或批大小；二是纯训练后量化存在优化上限，与使用大量迭代微调的方法相比仍有边际精度差距，未来可探索在二值基上加入轻量参数高效微调。此外，摘要未提供，需查看全文：未给出所有模型规模与所有基线配置下的完整数字，部分扩展实验与能耗细节位于附录。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化直接相关，属于超低位（约 2 比特）训练后量化方向，通过二值基组合与混合精度显著列精修降低权重位宽。与 KV cache 的关系：论文在实验设置中提到使用静态 KV cache 以配合 CUDA graphs 测量真实内核延迟，但未提出针对 KV cache 的量化方法，也未报告 KV cache 压缩结果。与长程 Agent / 多步工具调用量化的关系：论文未涉及 Agent、多步工具调用或长上下文场景的实验，因此没有直接证据表明其在该场景下的效果；其解码阶段加速与内存压缩可能对长程生成有潜在收益，但这属于推测而非论文实验结论。

papers.title: When Entropy Is Not Enough: Reclaiming Lost Semantics in LLM Output Length Prediction
papers.abstract: Efficient LLM serving is often bottlenecked by the need to pad sequences to a fixed maximum length, and this wastes compute and degrades throughput. Predicting output lengths in advance makes it possible to adopt length-aware scheduling, and this reduces the overhead. This advantage is especially pronounced in long-context reasoning and reinforcement learning applications. Existing approaches, such as entropy-guided token pooling, use token-wise entropy as their primary signal, but they tend to ignore differences in semantic content across tokens. So, important tokens are often underweighted, and tokens carrying little information receive disproportionate emphasis. This hurts the reliability of length prediction. We introduce ESTP (Entropy-and-Semantic Token Pooling), a lightweight framework that addresses this issue by combining entropy with attention-based importance scores. These scores are derived directly from the self-attention weights computed during the LLM prefill phase, and this allows ESTP to capture both uncertainty and semantic importance with minimal additional computation. Since the framework reuses prefill activations, it adds almost no extra memory overhead and introduces only minimal latency. On the ForeLen benchmark, ESTP outperforms baseline methods, achieves better prediction accuracy and lower error rates in most scenarios. When integrated with a length-aware scheduler in end-to-end system tests, it further helps improve overall throughput and reduce the padding ratio. Our results offer a practical and effective building block for length-aware LLM serving systems.

summary.title_zh: 当熵不足够时：在LLM输出长度预测中找回丢失的语义
summary.tldr: 论文指出仅用token熵进行加权池化会忽略语义重要性，导致关键token被低估；提出ESTP框架，将基于自注意力权重的语义重要性与token熵线性融合，并沿用软标签分布回归头预测输出长度。在ForeLen基准和四个开源模型上，ESTP在多数场景下降低MAE、提升分桶准确率，并在端到端长度感知调度中提升吞吐、降低填充比例。
summary.contributions: 1）通过诊断实验验证熵与语义重要性之间存在系统性错配：高熵token中相当比例语义不重要，低熵token中相当比例语义关键。2）提出ESTP，将熵与基于注意力的语义重要性融合，并采用软标签回归头，额外推理开销极小。3）在ForeLen基准的多个模型和多数场景上降低MAE、提升分桶准确率，并在端到端系统中提升吞吐、降低填充比例。
summary.method: ESTP包含三部分：从LLM最后一层多头自注意力矩阵按列平均得到每个token的语义重要性S_j；按EGTP方式计算token熵H_i；将二者线性组合T_i=λ1·S_i+λ2·H_i，经温度缩放softmax归一化为权重e_i，对隐藏状态加权求和得到聚合表示h。预测头将连续长度离散为K个bin，构造随距离单调递减的软标签分布p，输出分类分布p_hat并以其期望作为回归结果y_hat，用交叉熵与MSE的加权组合损失训练。框架复用prefill阶段的隐藏状态与注意力，几乎不增加显存和延迟。
summary.results: 在ForeLen基准、Qwen2.5-3B/7B与Llama3.2-1B/3B四个模型上，ESTP在多数场景取得最低平均MAE，相比EGTP平均MAE降低超过9点，RL场景降低超过20点；RL场景p值远低于1%。在Qwen2.5-7B上RMSE在RL与Reasoning场景最优且平均最低。RL场景分桶准确率在Qwen2.5-3B/7B上整体超过70%。消融显示ESTP平均MAE最低（96.74），优于平均池化（129.83）、熵池化（112.45）和语义池化（99.74）；使用最后一层特征优于中间层。端到端在Llama3.2-3B上，Reasoning场景填充比例由EGTP的1.18降至0.37，吞吐由22.51升至23.46，平均JCT由8.33降至7.69；LongSeq场景吞吐由30.74升至48.45，平均JCT由6.07降至3.29。效率上ESTP延迟和显存低于依赖外部辅助模型的方法。
summary.limitations: 作者在结论中指出：基于注意力的语义代理是相关性而非因果性；依赖模型内部激活，因此对无法获取激活的闭源模型适用性受限。未来工作包括因果归因、黑盒适配和多特征融合。摘要与节选中未提供Agent或多步工具调用场景的实验，也未涉及量化或KV cache压缩实验。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化无直接关系，未涉及权重量化、激活量化或KV cache量化。与长程Agent/多步工具调用的关系是间接的：论文针对长上下文推理与动态RL采样等长度方差大的负载，通过预测输出长度实现长度感知调度，可减少填充浪费、提升吞吐，这类调度优化对长程Agent推理服务有潜在价值，但论文未做Agent或工具调用实验，属于应用层面的推测。与KV cache的关系同样间接：论文复用prefill阶段的隐藏状态和注意力权重，不修改或压缩KV cache，其长度预测可用于调度以间接影响KV cache占用，但论文未直接研究KV cache。

papers.title: SchurQuant: Groupwise Discrete Optimization for Layer-Wise LLM Quantization
papers.abstract: Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) enables the deployment of large language models under tight memory budgets, but accuracy often collapses at 2-3 bits. Existing backpropagation-free PTQ optimizers have two limitations: group decisions ignore the correction that the remaining continuous suffix can absorb, and discrete refinements typically keep the affine quantization grid fixed. We introduce SCHUROPT, which analytically eliminates the suffix's optimal continuous response, yielding an exact groupwise quadratic with Schur-complement curvature. It then alternates closed-form row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with coordinate descent over integer codes. With the GPTQ objective fixed, SCHUROPT improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 11.88 percentage points (pp). At higher precision, however, tighter reconstruction does not consistently improve end-model metrics. SCHURQUANT therefore combines SCHUROPT with quantized-prefix teacher reconstruction, reference-weight regularization, residual-add targets, and teacher-decision token weighting. Across eight Llama and Qwen models, SCHURQUANT achieves the highest mean zero-shot accuracy among the evaluated backpropagation free PTQ baselines, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.65 pp at 2 bits.

summary.title_zh: SchurQuant：面向逐层LLM量化的分组离散优化
summary.tldr: 论文提出SchurOpt，一种在逐层LLM权重量化中利用Schur补精确消除连续后缀最优响应、从而得到分组级精确二次目标并交替进行闭式逐行scale/zero-point重拟合与整数码坐标下降的离散优化器；再结合量化前缀教师重建、参考权重锚定、残差相加目标与教师决策token加权构成SchurQuant。在八个Llama与Qwen模型2至4比特量化中，SchurQuant在评估的无反向传播PTQ基线中取得最高平均零样本准确率，2比特时比最强基线高9.65个百分点。
summary.contributions: 1）推导出在固定前缀与最优连续后缀响应条件下的精确离散分组问题，并用联合闭式scale/zero-point重拟合与行并行坐标下降优化其(S,T)，作者强调贡献在于这种条件化而非坐标下降本身。2）将已有的参考权重正则化与残差相加重建整合进充分统计量，并提出教师决策token加权，在不改变SchurOpt的情况下改变代理目标。3）实验上分离优化器与目标的影响，在八个Llama与Qwen模型2至4比特量化下，SchurQuant在评估的无反向传播PTQ基线中取得最高平均零样本准确率，2比特时优势最大。
summary.method: 论文将权重量化目标写为含token权重Ω与参考权重锚定λ的二次形式，得到充分统计量G=XΩX^T+λI与C=YΩX^T+λWref。SchurOpt在当前分组Wc离散、后缀Wr连续的前提下，解析地最小化Wr得到Schur补S=Gcc−GcrGrr^{-1}Grc与约化线性项T，从而在S、T上优化分组：先用闭式解逐行更新scale与zero-point（枚举2^b个zero-point），再对整数码做坐标下降，并用P=(G[t:,t:])^{-1}的分块逆递推高效计算S与下一块。SchurQuant在SchurOpt之上加入量化前缀教师重建、参考权重锚定、残差相加目标以及教师决策token加权（对干净top-1预测已被量化前缀翻转的校准位置加权，ρ=8）。
summary.results: 在WikiText-2困惑度上，2比特时SchurQuant在全部八个模型上优于GPTQ，并避免Llama3.2-1B（3432.88降至79.19）、Llama3.2-3B（10549.22降至29.39）、Qwen3-0.6B（12027.65降至74.72）的极端崩溃；3比特在八个模型中七个最优；4比特在五个模型最优。零样本平均准确率方面，2比特SchurQuant在八个模型上均最优，平均50.83%，比QEP高9.65个百分点、比GPTQ高11.58个百分点；3比特平均65.11%，比QEP高2.16个百分点；4比特平均67.54%，优势缩小至0.68个百分点。优化器消融显示，在GPTQ目标固定下，SchurOpt将2比特Qwen3-4B的PPL从258.96降至81.95、准确率从36.77%提升至48.65%（+11.88个百分点），但3、4比特时PPL变差而平均准确率变化仅−0.12与+0.08个百分点。收敛实验显示PPL在R=4附近饱和。
summary.limitations: 作者列出两点：一是SchurQuant因反复校准与离散精化，离线量化成本高于现有PTQ方法，限制其向更大模型扩展；二是优化逐层代理目标并不总能转化为端任务性能提升，且评估仅限非对称量化，更广的量化设置留待未来工作。附录C给出运行时间：2比特时SchurQuant在Qwen3-4B/Llama2-7B上约为GPTQ的45.8倍/31.8倍、QEP的4.6倍/5.8倍。
summary.relevance: 该论文直接研究大语言模型的权重量化（weight-only PTQ），属于大模型量化范畴，但聚焦于权重离散优化器与逐层代理目标，不涉及激活量化或KV cache量化，也未涉及长程Agent或多步工具调用场景。论文未包含任何Agent实验，因此其方法对长程Agent/多步工具调用量化的作用属于推测而非论文结论；若Agent场景依赖低比特权重部署，其2比特精度提升可能间接相关，但论文未验证。与KV cache无直接关系，论文未讨论KV cache量化。

papers.title: FlashQuant: Sparse-Dense Fusion for Memory-Efficient Outlier-Aware LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and computational cost of large language model (LLM) inference. However, high-magnitude outlier weights can induce substantial quantization errors and degrade model accuracy. Outlier-aware quantization addresses this issue by retaining outliers in high precision while quantizing the remaining weights, resulting in a low-bit dense GEMM path and a high-precision sparse SpMM path. Existing implementations execute these paths in separate GPU kernels, despite their shared activations and outputs, thereby missing opportunities for intra-operator reuse and incurring redundant global-memory accesses. This inefficiency is particularly pronounced in memory-bound decoding workloads. We propose FlashQuant, a content-sharing execution framework for outlier-aware W4A16 decoding. FlashQuant fuses the dense GEMM and sparse outlier SpMM paths into a single GPU kernel, enabling on-chip reuse of activation and output tiles across heterogeneous computations. It introduces three key techniques: sparse-dense tiling, which aligns outlier processing with dense GEMM tiles; Tile-COO outlier encoding, which enables efficient sparse access and reduces shared-memory bank conflicts; and pipelined scheduling, which overlaps computation with data movement. Experiments show that FlashQuant reduces outlier-processing overhead, achieving $2.74\times - 4.18\times$ speedup over cuBLAS BF16 and up to $1.53\times$ speedup over the strongest unfused outlier-aware baseline.

summary.title_zh: FlashQuant：面向内存高效离群值感知大模型推理的稀疏-稠密融合
summary.tldr: FlashQuant 是一个针对离群值感知 W4A16 解码的统一执行框架，将低比特稠密 GEMM 路径与高精度稀疏离群值 SpMM 路径融合进单个 GPU 内核，通过稀疏-稠密分块、Tile-COO 离群值编码和流水线调度实现片上激活与输出复用，减少冗余全局内存访问。
summary.contributions: 论文声称的贡献包括：指出冗余内存访问是离群值感知量化推理的关键系统瓶颈，因为现有实现将量化稠密路径与稀疏离群值路径放在不同 GPU 内核中执行；提出 FlashQuant 统一稀疏-稠密执行框架，把低比特 GEMM 与高精度 SpMM 融合到单个 GPU 内核，并通过稀疏-稠密分块、Tile-COO 编码和流水线调度提升效率；在多种 GPU 代际的代表性大模型算子上评估，显示相对离群值感知基线持续降低离群值处理开销并提升吞吐。
summary.method: FlashQuant 面向解码阶段的小批量场景，分为离线预处理与在线推理两阶段。预处理阶段做离群值感知量化，把权重分解为低比特量化矩阵 W_Q 与稀疏高精度离群值矩阵 W_O，并采用统一的稀疏-稠密分块使两者对齐；离群值以 Tile-COO 格式编码（tile_indptr、bucket_info、packed_outliers 三个数组，行/列索引用 uint8，值用 BF16，每四个离群值打包为 uint4），并做列重排序（按非零数降序加最小堆贪心分配以平衡桶负载）与元素重排序（按 bank group 循环顺序减少共享内存 bank 冲突）。在线推理阶段把稠密与稀疏计算融合进单个内核：CTA 级共享激活 tile 并片上累加部分结果，采用 Stream-K 改善负载均衡；warp 级将稠密路径映射到 Tensor Core MMA，稀疏路径映射到 CUDA Core 并分配不相交输出列以避免写冲突，必要时给稀疏路径增加 warp；thread 级对激活采用行主序加 8 元素 swizzle 布局。实现上采用多阶段双缓冲流水线，重叠全局内存加载、寄存器暂存、反量化与离群值解码、Tensor Core 与 CUDA Core 计算，并使用优化的离群值解码过程（双缓冲预取、swizzle 复用、四次展开 FMA）。
summary.results: 在 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090、4090、5090 上，针对从 LLaMA、Qwen、DeepSeek、OPT 提取的算子形状（问题规模从 (4096,4096) 到 (75264,14848)，离群值比例 1.0%–3.0%，共 340 个 INT4+BF16 配置），batch size 为 8 和 16 时，FlashQuant 相对 cuBLAS BF16 取得 2.74×–4.18× 加速；相对最强非融合基线 Sputnik+Marlin，在 RTX 3090 上为 1.03×–1.16×，RTX 4090 上为 1.12×–1.37×，RTX 5090 上为 1.23×–1.53×。离群值密度增加时 FlashQuant 延迟增长小于 Sputnik；在新 GPU 上优势更明显。batch size 32 时仍优于基线，但 batch 小于 8 时因填充到最小 8 而优势减弱。消融显示仅启用稀疏-稠密分块相对 Sputnik+Marlin 提速 6%–16%，额外 warp 分配再提速 2%–4%，重排序再提速 4%–9%；内存流量相对 Sputnik 最多降低 45.4%。预处理时间在所有评估矩阵上低于 100 秒。端到端在 LLaMA3-8B 与 Qwen2.5-14B 上，batch size 8 时相对 BF16 基线提速 2.01×，batch size 16 时提速 1.98×；Qwen2.5 在 BF16 下显存不足而量化后可运行。WikiText2 困惑度方面，离群值感知量化相对 GPTQ 在仅少量内存开销下持续降低困惑度。
summary.limitations: 论文自述当前 FlashQuant 仅针对 INT4 权重量化加 BF16 离群值，并依赖离线预处理生成 Tile-COO 表示，未来工作才扩展到 INT2 等更低精度格式。评估显示 batch size 小于 8 时因填充到最小 8 引入冗余计算、并行效率下降，优势减弱。端到端结果中 FlashQuant 吞吐低于 Marlin（但精度更高），且相对 cuSPARSE 开销更小。摘要与节选未提供其他限制，需查看全文。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化直接相关：它研究离群值感知权重量化（W4A16）推理，把低比特稠密 GEMM 与高精度稀疏离群值 SpMM 融合为单内核，属于量化推理系统优化。与 KV cache 的关系：论文聚焦权重离群值与解码阶段 GEMM/SpMM，未涉及 KV cache 的量化或管理，节选中没有 KV cache 相关实验或讨论。与长程 Agent / 多步工具调用量化的关系：论文没有 Agent、多步工具调用或长上下文场景的实验，其相关性仅在于所优化的解码阶段内存受限 GEMM 是自回归生成（包括 Agent 多步调用中逐 token 解码）的底层算子；对 Agent 应用的收益属于推测，论文未做 Agent 实验验证。

papers.title: Every Expert Counts: ExactMoE for Memory-Efficient W4A16 Inference
papers.abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models reduce arithmetic by activating only a small subset of experts per token, yet deployment still requires storing and moving the full expert bank. We present ExactMoE, an inference design that applies symmetric group-128 four-bit weight quantization only to routed experts, stores those experts in kernel-native MARLIN form in pinned host memory, and executes all selected experts through a configurable GPU-resident slot cache and fused grouped MoE kernels. The router, attention, embeddings, normalization layers, and language-model head remain in BF16. "Exact" refers to complete expert availability and an unchanged top-k routing procedure: no expert is pruned, substituted, or forced to execute on the CPU. It does not imply numerical identity with the BF16 model. On OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct, evaluated on a single NVIDIA L4, a 16-slot configuration reduces peak reserved GPU memory from 14.168 to 1.836 GiB (87.04%) while retaining 81.85% of BF16 decode throughput. A fully resident 64-slot configuration reaches 31.923 tokens/s versus 21.662 tokens/s for BF16 while reserving 4.061 GiB. Across 12,450 zero-shot multiple-choice questions, ExactMoE obtains 70.3534% normalized accuracy versus 70.8996% for BF16, retaining 99.23% of the baseline accuracy. In a matched 16-token ablation, fused grouped execution is 1.97x as fast as a sequential W4 reference. These results identify a practical memory-transfer-throughput frontier for complete-expert MoE inference.

summary.title_zh: 每个专家都算数：ExactMoE 面向内存高效 W4A16 推理
summary.tldr: 论文提出 ExactMoE，一种针对稀疏混合专家（MoE）大模型的推理设计：仅对路由专家做对称分组 128 的 4 比特权重量化（W4A16），并以 MARLIN 内核原生格式同时存放于固定主机内存与可配置 GPU 槽位缓存中，通过融合分组 MoE 内核执行全部被选中的专家。在 OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct 与单张 NVIDIA L4 上，16 槽配置把峰值预留 GPU 内存从 14.168 GiB 降到 1.836 GiB（降低 87.04%），同时保留 BF16 解码吞吐的 81.85%；64 槽全驻留配置达到 31.923 tokens/s，高于 BF16 的 21.662 tokens/s。质量上在 12,450 道零样本多选题上归一化准确率为 70.3534%，相对 BF16 的 70.8996% 保留 99.23%，但配对检验显示存在小幅但统计可检测的下降。
summary.contributions: 论文自述贡献为系统与实证层面：一是定义“完整专家”W4A16 执行契约，路由器和稠密组件保持 BF16，仅量化路由专家投影；二是实现内核原生离线打包、固定主机内存存储、可配置槽位驻留、批量专家 ID 解析与基于波次的融合执行，且不物化 FP16 专家；三是在同一检查点与同一硬件上对 BF16 与 ExactMoE 做受控对比，覆盖质量、延迟、吞吐、内存、传输量、缓存行为与配对统计；四是区分三个常被混淆的概念：完整专家可用性、量化隐状态下路由的忠实性、与 BF16 的数值等价性，并明确 ExactMoE 只保证前两者。
summary.method: 方法要点：对每个专家矩阵按输入维度以 128 为一组做对称分组量化，缩放因子为该组绝对值最大值除以 7，量化值裁剪到 -8 到 7，全零组直接令缩放与量化值为 0；量化与打包离线完成一次，gate 与 up 投影按融合内核要求的顺序拼接，down 投影单独打包。每个稀疏层拥有容量为 C 的专家槽位缓存（k ≤ C ≤ E），槽位存放打包的 gate/up、down 权重及其 FP16 缩放；主机池以固定内存存放同一内核原生表示，缓存未命中时直接异步拷贝最终内核表示，不物化 FP16 专家。缓存维护全局专家到槽位的映射与最近使用时间戳，用 CUDA 事件防止槽位在计算完成前被覆盖；当 C=E 时全部预加载并禁用专家 ID 传输与替换。执行时把该层活跃专家集合划分为不超过 C 个专家的波次，每波解析或加载专家、构建全局 ID 到槽位的映射（其余映射到非活跃哨兵）、调用融合 MARLIN MoE 内核处理完整 token 矩阵、累加波次输出并记录完成事件；每波执行两次分组专家 GEMM（一次融合 gate/up，一次 down），而非每个专家一次调用。路由器权重跨波保留且不在波内重新归一化。正确性检查分三层：内核测试对比 MARLIN 输出与物化反量化 W4 参考；融合与顺序 W4 消融检查贪心 token 与末位 logits 容差；端到端 BF16 对比衡量专家量化的实际质量影响。
summary.results: 实验在 OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct（16 个稀疏层、每层 64 专家、top-8 路由、隐藏维度 2048、专家中间维度 1024、路由专家参数 6.44B）与单张 NVIDIA L4（22.0 GiB 可用 GPU 内存、53 GiB 主机内存）上进行。内存-吞吐前沿：C=16 时峰值预留 GPU 内存从 14.168 GiB 降至 1.836 GiB（降低 87.04%），解码吞吐 17.731 tokens/s，为 BF16 的 81.85%，每 128 token 请求中位主机到设备传输 21.44 GiB，TTFT 中位 290 ms；C=32 命中率 81.4%，解码吞吐 21.66 tokens/s 接近 BF16，预留内存仍降低 81.8%；C=64 全驻留预留 4.061 GiB，达 31.923 tokens/s，比 BF16 高 47.4%。质量：12,450 道配对多选题归一化准确率 70.3534% 对 BF16 的 70.8996%，保留 99.23%，绝对变化 -0.546 个百分点，配对 95% bootstrap 区间 [-0.964, -0.137]，McNemar p=0.0112；分任务看 ARC-Easy +0.35、PIQA +0.05、HellaSwag -0.71 个百分点；WikiText 困惑度上升 3.85%，Dolly 困惑度下降 1.46%。融合消融：在匹配 16 槽缓存与相同 W4 权重下，顺序参考 9.36 tokens/s，融合分组执行 18.43 tokens/s，加速 1.97 倍，两者生成完全相同的 16 个贪心 token，末位 logits 最大绝对差 0.421875。内核测试覆盖 token 组大小 1 到 128，相对物化反量化 W4 参考的最大相对平均误差 0.00560；融合 MoE 预检最大绝对误差 0.00098。批量生成（16 槽）：batch 1 为 15.74 tokens/s，batch 8 为 90.02 tokens/s，此时超过 BF16 的 65.25 tokens/s，且预留内存约 1.86 GiB 对 14.68 GiB。
summary.limitations: 论文自述局限：ExactMoE 以 GPU 内存换取主机容量与数据搬运，未驻留 GPU 的被选专家必须从打包主机池传输，性能依赖路由局部性、缓存容量、主机到 GPU 带宽与传输延迟，专家复用有限时频繁未命中会抵消卸载收益；完整打包专家池必须能放入主机内存；只有路由专家权重被量化，注意力、路由、嵌入、归一化、共享组件与语言模型头仍为稠密精度，因此内存节省取决于路由专家参数占比；W4A16 不保持与 BF16 的数值一致性，量化会改变专家输出、隐状态、token 概率与后续路由决策，路由轨迹不必与 BF16 一致，质量保留率可能随模型、任务与专家变化；实现要求 MARLIN 兼容的维度与分组约束以及 NVIDIA GPU，其他专家布局可能需要填充、不同打包或另一融合内核，支持新架构还需正确映射检查点张量；该方法面向单设备固定权重推理，更新专家需要重新打包，多 GPU 放置、分布式缓存协调与持续服务调度器需要额外系统支持。此外，评估范围限于一个检查点与一块 GPU，提示重复共享持久进程，估计的是进程内变异而非跨进程或跨机器方差；批量扫描每个批量点仅测一次且不含请求调度器；未在同一硬件上复现外部 MoE 量化或卸载系统，因此结果只说明该实现的质量-内存-吞吐权衡，而非对现有服务系统的普遍优越性。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化直接相关：它研究 MoE 路由专家的 W4A16 权重量化（对称分组 128、MARLIN 内核原生打包），并给出量化后相对 BF16 的质量保留与统计显著性。与 KV cache 的关系：论文未涉及 KV cache 量化或 KV cache 管理，其内存节省来自专家权重的 4 比特表示与分层驻留，摘要与正文均未报告 KV cache 相关实验，因此不能推断其对 KV cache 的影响。与长程 Agent / 多步工具调用量化的关系：论文没有 Agent、工具调用或多步推理实验，也未评估长上下文或长程任务下的量化误差累积；其相关性仅在于为在显存受限设备上部署 MoE 模型提供了内存-吞吐权衡数据，可能对需要本地部署 Agent 的场景有间接参考价值，但这属于推测而非论文结论。论文明确区分“完整专家可用性”“路由忠实性”与“与 BF16 数值等价”，并指出量化会改变隐状态与后续路由决策，这一点对任何依赖多步一致性的 Agent 应用都值得注意，但论文本身未做此类实验。

papers.title: AudioTQ: A Data-Oblivious 6-Bit CPU Audio Codec via Randomized Hadamard Rotation and Lloyd-Max Quantization
papers.abstract: Lossy audio compression algorithms traditionally rely on psychoacoustic modeling and frequency-domain representations (e.g., MP3, AAC, and Opus) to discard information that is imperceptible to the human auditory system. While highly effective, these approaches are computationally complex and domain-specific. In this paper, we present the design and mathematical formulation of AudioTQ, a data-oblivious lossy audio codec that operates directly in the time domain. Inspired by Large Language Model (LLM) weight quantization techniques (specifically the TurboQuant framework), AudioTQ uniformizes volatile time-domain amplitudes into a predictable standard normal distribution using an orthonormal, randomized Fast Walsh-Hadamard Transform (FWHT) rotation. This enables coordinate-wise scalar quantization using an offline-trained, MSE-optimal 6-bit Lloyd-Max quantizer, augmented by a 1-bit Quantized Joint Least-Squares (QJL) residual correction layer. The resulting 7-bit virtual indices are packed into native 8-bit containers, aligning with standard CPU register boundaries to ensure real-time single-threaded execution without hardware parallel accelerators. We detail the bitwise reconstruction of 24-bit studio stems, analyze the butterfly network of the FWHT, derive the mathematical failure modes under sparse inputs, and present benchmarks showing up to 74.4% physical size reduction alongside a Signal-to-Quantization-Noise Ratio (SQNR) of ~30 dB.

summary.title_zh: AudioTQ：一种基于随机Hadamard旋转与Lloyd-Max量化的数据无关6比特CPU音频编解码器
summary.tldr: 该论文提出AudioTQ，一种受大语言模型权重量化（TurboQuant）启发的、数据无关的时域有损音频编解码器。它通过随机化快速Walsh-Hadamard变换（FWHT）旋转将音频幅度分布高斯化，再用离线训练的6比特Lloyd-Max量化器加1比特QJL残差校正进行量化，并将7比特虚拟索引打包进8比特字节以适配CPU寄存器。摘要与节选报告称在语音与音乐素材上实现最高约74.4%的物理体积缩减，SQNR约30 dB。
summary.contributions: 1) 将LLM权重量化中的随机正交旋转思想迁移到时域音频压缩，提出数据无关的编解码框架；2) 设计随机化FWHT加符号矩阵的旋转流程，使任意音频块系数趋近标准正态分布；3) 采用离线经验Lloyd-Max 6比特量化器并叠加1比特QJL残差符号校正，形成虚拟7比特分辨率；4) 提出6+1比特字节对齐打包与L1缓存对齐分块，面向单线程CPU实时执行；5) 给出稀疏输入下Hadamard基对齐失败模式的理论分析及缓解策略。
summary.method: 输入为24比特PCM，按位重组为32位有符号整数并归一化到[-1,1]。对大小为B（B=512）的块先乘以静态伪随机±1对角矩阵S，再做正交归一化FWHT（蝶形网络，O(B log B)），随后减去均值并除以标准差做标准化，静音块用阈值保护。标准化系数用离线训练的6比特Lloyd-Max量化器（64个质心，20次Lloyd迭代）量化，再对残差记录1比特符号并用块内平均绝对误差Δ做重建校正。压缩端将6比特质心索引左移1位与1比特QJL标志打包进uint8，每块另存μ、σ、Δ各4字节元数据。解压端逆序执行。
summary.results: 节选给出的基准：语音参考轨原始2.52 MB（15秒@44.1 kHz），压缩后0.65 MB，压缩比3.91倍（74.4%），SQNR 30.24 dB，互相关99.96%，峰值包络差<0.0003，压缩速度1.32 MB/s，解压速度1.35 MB/s；录音室音乐素材原始52.93 MB，压缩后17.64 MB，压缩比3.00倍（66.6%），SQNR 29.74 dB，互相关99.95%，峰值包络差0.0002，压缩速度1.31 MB/s，解压速度1.35 MB/s。理论压缩比2048字节/524字节≈3.91倍。与均匀量化对比为理论分析（6比特均匀约25.8 dB、7比特约31.8 dB，假设波峰因数15 dB），并非直接实验对比。作者称通过动态Lloyd-Max求解器、显式均值中心化和将QJL残差乘子从1.22改回1.0，将早期约24.6 dB的瓶颈提升到约30 dB。
summary.limitations: 节选仅给出摘要与部分正文，未提供完整实验设置、数据集规模、主观听感评测、与其他编解码器的实际对比实验，也未给出统计显著性。失败模式分析（Hadamard基对齐导致SQNR降至1.31 dB）为理论推导，缓解策略（动态符号调制、亚LSB抖动）被描述为可实施的生产防护，但节选未报告其实际验证结果。压缩/解压速度仅约1.3 MB/s，作者在结论中承认未来需研究SIMD向量化与子带分解。摘要未提供，需查看全文以确认更多实验细节与局限。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化的关系是方法迁移：它直接借鉴LLM权重量化框架TurboQuant的随机正交旋转加标量量化思路，把权重量化中的离群值平滑、Lloyd-Max码本和QJL残差校正用于音频时域信号，属于量化技术跨域应用，而非对LLM本身的量化研究。与长程Agent/多步工具调用量化的关系：论文未涉及Agent、工具调用、推理链或KV cache，节选未提供任何Agent实验，因此不能推断其在Agent场景下的效果；仅可推测其低比特、数据无关、CPU友好的量化思路或对KV cache压缩有概念上的借鉴意义，但这属于推测而非论文结论。与KV cache的关系：论文未研究KV cache，仅在动机部分提及LLM权重量化，未涉及KV cache的压缩或量化。

papers.title: LOCAL: Enabling Learning On-device Contiguously for Agent LLMs
papers.abstract: On-device LLM agents interact repeatedly with users on local hardware, producing private traces that are valuable for adaptation but should not be sent to a remote trainer. Ideally, such agents would learn contiguously---adapting from every interaction without pausing or suspending user-facing inference---yet existing inference runtimes assume stable weights and existing RL systems assume separated resources, so neither can support this continuity. We present LOCAL, the first single-GPU runtime that enables contiguous on-device learning for LLM agents. The key insight is that GPU scheduling, adapter version management, and KV-cache validity cannot be handled by independent subsystems: adapter updates invalidate cached KV tensors from older versions, and cache retention affects the memory available for training. LOCAL makes adapter version, task priority, and cache state visible to three cooperating components---a cooperative scheduler, a version-aware KV-cache manager, and a multi-agent model runtime---that share this state to keep scheduling, execution, and cache maintenance mutually consistent. On a single 24 GB GPU with 7B-class models, LOCAL lowers foreground queue-wait p95 by 3.1x over FIFO, lowers p95 time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 1.55x versus non-preemptible training, cuts post-publish first-hit prefill p99 by 25.6% and cross-agent TTFT p99 by 21.9%, and keeps background learning progressing under tight KV budgets.

summary.title_zh: LOCAL：为 Agent 大模型实现端侧连续学习
summary.tldr: 论文提出 LOCAL，一个单 GPU 运行时，让端侧 LLM Agent 在不中断前台推理的情况下持续进行 LoRA 适配器在线学习。核心思路是让调度器、模型运行时和 KV cache 管理器共享适配器版本、任务优先级与缓存有效性状态，从而解决前台-后台资源争用、适配器更新导致的 KV 失效以及显存受限三大耦合问题。
summary.contributions: （1）设计协作式调度器，集中管理 GPU 准入，前台推理严格优先，后台判分、训练与缓存刷新任务以有界分块形式在安全边界让出；（2）设计版本感知 KV cache 管理器，将适配器版本纳入缓存键，拒绝过期覆盖，并基于热前缀统计决定保留、刷新或卸载；（3）设计多 Agent 模型运行时，引入 agent 作用域 KV 身份与适配器作用域失效，并提出跨 Agent 预预填充。
summary.method: LOCAL 位于本地 Agent API 与单一模型实例之间，由三个共享状态的组件构成：协作式调度器（唯一 GPU 准入点，前台队列严格优先，后台任务仅在安全 yield/commit 边界以有界块运行，训练采用协作式中断契约）；版本感知 KV cache 管理器（缓存有效性键为 token span、上下文命名空间、适配器、适配器版本四元组，维护前缀热度与适配器热度，发布新版本前对热前缀执行 stale-coverage prefill，显存压力下按保留优先级卸载冷条目，使用基数索引前缀表分离逻辑有效性与物理驻留）；多 Agent 运行时（执行推理与训练、感知显存压力、提出跨 Agent 预预填充任务，但不绕过调度器）。原型面向单 GPU、单基座模型、LoRA 风格适配器更新，不假设远程 rollout/reward/训练集群。
summary.results: 在单张 24GB RTX 3090 级 GPU、7B 级模型（xLAM-7b-r，LoRA rank 4）上，使用 tau-bench retail 训练集进行 24 任务实验。前台优先调度相比 FIFO 将前台队列等待 p95 降低 3.1 倍、p99 降低 3.4 倍，并完成 34 次适配器训练提交；相比轮询，p99 队列等待低 2.1 倍且训练提交多 1.6 倍。可中断训练使 p95 TTFT 比不可抢占训练低 1.55 倍，训练导致的累计阻塞减少 2.6 倍，但有效训练吞吐从 346.8 降至 271.8 步/小时（下降 21.6%）。相比 vLLM full-LoRA sleep/train/wake 路径，LOCAL 在不同准入策略下 p95 队列等待低 5.9 至 12.8 倍。stale-coverage prefill 使发布后首次命中 prefill p99 降低 25.6%（均值降 25.8%，p95 降 22.0%）。跨 Agent 预预填充使跨 Agent TTFT p99 降低 21.9%（均值降 38.0%，p95 降 12.8%）。峰值 GPU 显存范围为 21.6GB 至 23.5GB。
summary.limitations: 摘要与节选未提供完整的局限性讨论，需查看全文。从已有内容可知：实验为机制级评估，tau-bench 成功率和奖励仅用于确认运行完成，不作为模型质量结论；可中断训练会降低有效训练吞吐约 21.6%；原型仅面向单 GPU、单基座模型与 LoRA 风格更新，不涉及远程集群；跨 Agent 预预填充在单 Agent 部署中基本不适用。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化无直接关系，未涉及权重量化、低比特推理或量化误差分析。与长程 Agent / 多步工具调用量化的关系在于：它面向端侧多轮 Agent 场景，处理长上下文 KV cache 的版本有效性与显存受限问题，但并未研究量化方法本身。与 KV cache 的关系最为直接：论文的核心贡献之一是版本感知 KV cache 管理，将适配器版本纳入缓存键，提出 agent 作用域 KV 身份、热前缀统计、stale-coverage prefill 与优先级卸载，解决适配器更新后旧 KV 张量失效的问题。论文没有进行 Agent 量化实验，也未评估量化对 Agent 多步工具调用性能的影响；相关 Agent 应用层面的结论属于运行时调度与缓存管理的直接实验结论，而非量化推测。

papers.title: TRACE-BN: Transferring Bangla-English Tutoring Behavior to a Sub-1B Offline Language Model
papers.abstract: Bangla-English tutoring requires more than producing a correct translation: learners also need explanations of grammar differences, awareness of their likely errors, and targeted practice. We present TRACE-BN, a curriculum-guided dataset of structured tutoring traces for Bangla-speaking learners of English at the CEFR A1-A2 level. Each trace combines word-level glosses, literal and natural translations, Bangla grammar explanations, a plausible learner error, and a targeted practice question with its answer. The traces are generated by Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite as the teacher model from NCTB Classes 9-10 English curriculum units, then filtered for structural validity, script integrity, and semantic duplication. We transfer the resulting structured tutoring behavior to Qwen3-0.6B using LoRA with 4-bit quantization for resource-constrained offline deployment. On held-out inputs, schema validity increases from 85.4% to 95.8%, while, against teacher-model references, chrF++ improves from 15.28 to 34.77 and BLEU from 4.52 to 21.03. Field-level evaluation by two independent judges shows improvements across translation, grammar explanation, learner-error diagnosis, and practice alignment, while a human audit supports the quality of the supervision data. The results show that curriculum-guided structured supervision can transfer multi-component tutoring behavior to a sub-1B model under these resource constraints. The dataset, model checkpoints, and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/RaiyanKhaan/Trace-BN

summary.title_zh: TRACE-BN：将孟加拉语-英语辅导行为迁移至亚十亿参数离线语言模型
summary.tldr: 论文构建了TRACE-BN数据集，包含4099条由Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite依据NCTB九至十年级英语课程生成的七字段结构化辅导轨迹（词级注释、直译、自然翻译、孟加拉语语法说明、常见学习者错误、练习问题及答案），并用LoRA加4比特量化将其迁移到Qwen3-0.6B。在432条留出样本上，模式有效率从85.4%升至95.8%，chrF++从15.28升至34.77，BLEU从4.52升至21.03，字段级双评委评分在所有辅导维度上均有提升。
summary.contributions: 提出TRACE-BN，一个课程引导的孟加拉语-英语双语辅导数据集，每条轨迹含七个字段，覆盖翻译、对比性语法解释、学习者错误预测与针对性练习；提出将翻译与语法解释、错误预测、练习生成整合在单一轨迹中的结构化辅导任务形式；开展实证适配研究，表明Qwen3-0.6B在LoRA微调下可学会生成TRACE-BN结构，并给出字段级评估与对监督数据的人工验证。
summary.method: 数据集基于NCTB九至十年级英语课程，人工选定单元、主题与语法覆盖，覆盖15个CEFR A1-A2主题簇与13个语法单元。以Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite为教师模型，按指定提示模板生成严格JSON的七字段轨迹，随后经三重过滤：结构校验（合法JSON、七字段齐全、非空语法说明、词注释长度在源句长度0.5至2.0倍之间）、Unicode脚本校验（防止跨语言串写）、基于paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2句嵌入的语义去重（同主题簇内余弦相似度大于0.92）。4450条候选中剔除351条（7.9%），最终4099条，划分为3667条训练与432条评估（按主题簇划分，含天气与习语等留出域）。用Unsloth在单张16GB Colab T4上以LoRA（r=16，α=32，dropout为0，目标q、k、v、o、gate、up、down投影层）加4比特量化微调Qwen3-0.6B，训练三个epoch共621步，余弦学习率峰值2e-4。评估包括模式有效率、BLEU、chrF++（以教师模型输出为银参考）、双自动评委（GPT-4o-mini与DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731）的七维0-4分字段级评分、二次加权Cohen κ一致性、配对自助重采样1000次，以及100条轨迹的人工审核。
summary.results: 在432条留出样本上，微调后Qwen3-0.6B模式有效率由85.4%升至95.8%（无效输出由63条降至18条），chrF++由15.28升至34.77（相对基座提升19.49，p<0.05），BLEU由4.52升至21.03；相对TigerLLM-1B的chrF++提升12.54（p<0.05）。Gemma-4 E2B（2.3B）翻译最强，chrF++ 50.91、BLEU 33.54，但吞吐低于微调模型（45.97对75.47 tokens/s）。字段级评分（0-4）中，微调模型词注释1.48、直译1.33、自然翻译1.31、语法解释1.48、错误诊断1.47、练习对齐1.17、整体辅导质量1.14，均高于基座（0.10至0.27），但绝对分数仍偏低；评委一致性在词注释、直译、自然翻译、整体质量上为显著（κ 0.700-0.803），语法解释、错误诊断、练习对齐为中等（κ 0.489-0.585）。消融显示仅翻译训练chrF++为31.84，加解释为33.12，完整七字段为34.77。人工审核100条轨迹在五个教学维度上均值为4.44至4.81，95.7%评分不低于4。定性上，剩余错误集中在留出习语与细粒度词注释。
summary.limitations: 翻译指标以教师模型输出为银参考，衡量的是与教师参考的一致度而非独立判定的翻译质量；字段级绝对评分仍低于评分量表上端，说明辅导质量有限；剩余错误集中于留出习语与细粒度词注释；评委在语法解释、错误诊断、练习对齐上一致性仅为中等；论文明确说明是否真正提升学习者英语水平需要受控学习者研究，尚未验证；摘要与节选未提供关于长上下文、KV cache或Agent场景的任何实验。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化的关系在于：使用4比特量化加LoRA在单张16GB GPU上微调0.6B模型，并导出GGUF在llama.cpp本地推理验证输出一致，属于面向资源受限离线部署的量化适配实践，但未研究量化对精度的影响机制或不同量化位宽的对比。与长程Agent或多步工具调用量化无直接关系：论文未涉及Agent、工具调用、多步推理或长程任务，也未评估KV cache的量化或内存占用。论文中的“结构化生成”指单次响应内生成七字段JSON轨迹，属于结构化输出可靠性问题，而非多步工具调用链。若将其用于Agent场景（如把辅导轨迹生成作为工具调用的一步），属于推测，论文本身没有相应实验。

papers.title: P-PAS: Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Long-context LLM applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic systems often process tens of thousands of input tokens to produce short outputs, making end-to-end request latency an important serving objective. We show that the maximum number of batched tokens (MBT), which controls the token scheduling budget in vLLM, has a scheduling-pressure-dependent effect on latency. Larger token budgets can reduce latency under low scheduling pressure, while smaller budgets become preferable under higher pressure. Consequently, no single static MBT performs best across load regimes. We introduce Prefill-Pressure Adaptive Scheduling (P-PAS), a lightweight policy that dynamically adapts the scheduling budget based on concurrent prefill and decode state. P-PAS retains a large token budget under low pressure and constrains prefill work as pressure increases. Across models, workloads, and GPUs, P-PAS maintains low end-to-end latency across changing load regimes, avoiding the limitations of a fixed MBT. Kernel-level profiling shows that large prefill chunks can improve execution efficiency under low scheduling pressure, but that this advantage varies across model--hardware configurations. As scheduling pressure increases, smaller chunks can instead reduce interference with active decoding, explaining the observed load-dependent MBT sensitivity. Code and artifacts for reproducing our results are available at https://github.com/TimoSaemann/ppas-vllm .

summary.title_zh: P-PAS：面向长上下文大语言模型服务的预填充压力自适应调度
summary.tldr: 论文针对长上下文、短输出的大语言模型服务场景，指出 vLLM 中最大批处理令牌数（MBT）对延迟的影响取决于调度压力：低压力下较大预算更优，高压力下较小预算更优，因此不存在单一静态最优 MBT。作者提出 P-PAS，一种基于并发预填充与解码状态在线调整预填充令牌预算的轻量调度策略，并在多种模型、负载与 GPU 上验证其能在变化负载下保持较低端到端延迟。
summary.contributions: 论文声称的贡献包括：刻画长上下文短输出服务中的 MBT 敏感性，识别出延迟最优令牌预算随调度压力变化的负载相关交叉点；提出 P-PAS 轻量调度策略，依据预填充压力和活跃解码状态动态调整令牌预算，避免单一静态 MBT 选择；跨模型架构与规模、工作负载配置以及消费级与数据中心级 GPU 评估 P-PAS，显示其在变化负载下保持较低端到端延迟；提供内核级分析，说明预填充执行效率如何随分块大小变化，以及 MBT 敏感性为何因模型-硬件配置而异。
summary.method: P-PAS 是 vLLM 调度器的轻量扩展。每个调度迭代中，它统计运行中和等待中的预填充请求数 N_p 以及运行中的解码请求数 N_d；当 N_p 达到阈值 N_th 且至少有一个解码请求活跃时，判定存在预填充压力，将聚合预填充令牌预算限制为较小的 B_cap，否则使用较大的 B_max。全局 vLLM 令牌预算不变，P-PAS 仅增加对单次迭代内聚合预填充令牌的额外约束。评估配置为 N_th=2、B_max=16384、B_cap=2048，且该配置在模型、负载和 GPU 间保持不变。策略仅使用调度器已有信息，无需离线负载预测或额外模型执行与性能分析。
summary.results: 主要实验使用 Qwen2.5-3B 在 NVIDIA RTX 5090 上，25k 提示令牌与 32 输出令牌，突发到达率 0.4 至 1.4 请求/秒。相对固定 MBT 2k，P-PAS 平均端到端延迟降低 8.5%，P95 延迟降低 3.0%，平均 TTFT 降低 11.8%，平均 TPOT 降低 3.4%，Makespan 降低 1.0%；相对固定 MBT 16k，平均延迟降低 11.3%，P95 延迟降低 10.0%，平均 TTFT 增加 18.5%，平均 TPOT 降低 36.3%，Makespan 增加 3.9%。鲁棒性实验中，Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-3B、SmolLM3-3B 在 RTX 5090 上相对两种固定 MBT 均降低平均延迟；提示长度 20k 至 30k、输出长度 16 至 64 令牌下多数配置也降低延迟，但 30k 提示时 P95 延迟相对 MBT 2k 差 2.7%；在 A100 SXM 上 Qwen2.5-3B 相对 MBT 2k 和 16k 平均延迟分别降低 7.8% 和 6.6%，SmolLM3-3B 分别降低 10.2% 和 5.4%。内核分析显示，Qwen2.5-0.5B 和 3B 将 MBT 从 2k 增至 16k 使总预填充时间分别减少 10.5% 和 11.6%，而 Qwen2.5-7B 仅减少 0.6%，其 MBT 敏感性较弱。
summary.limitations: 论文自述的局限与未来方向包括：需将评估扩展到更广的工作负载范围，包括更短和更长的提示以及更多样的输出长度；需研究 MBT 敏感性在更大模型上是否持续存在；P-PAS 配置本身目前使用固定压力阈值和预算水平，未来可使其自适应；需系统刻画模型架构与规模、工作负载特征和硬件如何决定 MBT 敏感性；需扩展到其他 GPU 平台与厂商，包括 AMD GPU。此外，论文指出在最高突发率 1.4 请求/秒时 MBT 2k 略优于 P-PAS，但在 1.6 请求/秒的补充实验中 P-PAS 重新占优；Qwen2.5-7B 上大 MBT 预填充优势很弱，P-PAS 的额外收益相应有限。
summary.relevance: 该论文与大模型量化没有直接关系，未涉及权重量化、激活量化或量化对调度的影响。与长程 Agent / 多步工具调用量化的关系是：论文将 RAG 和 agentic 系统作为长上下文、短输出的目标工作负载，并强调下游动作依赖完整响应，因此关注端到端请求延迟；但论文没有进行任何 Agent 或多步工具调用的实验，也没有涉及量化，相关联系属于应用场景层面的推测而非实验结论。与 KV cache 的关系是：论文在背景中说明预填充阶段将键和值存入 KV cache，解码阶段自回归生成；其调度分析涉及预填充与解码的干扰以及 KV 序列增长对分块执行时间的影响，但论文并未研究 KV cache 量化或压缩，也未给出 KV cache 量化实验。

papers.title: Anatomy of a Quantized Agent: VRAM Stability and Forecasting in Code-Synthesis Agentic Workloads
papers.abstract: Analytical models of peak VRAM consumption for LLM inference decompose memory into weight-storage, KV-cache, and activation terms parameterized by step count, tool invocations, and context expansion. We evaluate this decomposition empirically within a strictly scoped measurement study: a LangGraph-based CUDA-kernel-synthesis agent (AgentK), a 4-bit quantization family (Q4 K M), a single NVIDIA H100 GPU, and four LLM backbones across 1,920 trajectories. Focusing on peak-memory forecasting behavior, we report two primary observations. First, closed-form analytical models achieve competitive accuracy when provided with two empirical constants: loaded-weight VRAM and a fixed activation-memory overhead. Supplied with live GPU readings and ground-truth trajectory parameters, the closed-form model matches or outperforms the best learned baseline on three of the four backbones (test MAPE 2.2-4.4% vs. 3.4-6.5%, p = 0.76). The exception is the smallest backbone (Phi-4-mini), where minimal VRAM variance (CV 0.3%) causes dynamic modeling to underperform simple regression. Second, compile success strictly bifurcates by backbone capacity (from 5.7% for Phi-4-mini to 62.0% for Qwen2.5-Coder-14B), demonstrating that functional code synthesis remains constrained by intrinsic LLM capabilities rather than available memory. Furthermore, because overall peak-memory variance is remarkably low across all backbones (CV 0.3-9.4%), learned prompt-feature regression offers statistically insignificant improvements over a constant-mean baseline. Consequently, we find no justification for deploying complex predictive VRAM models in highly quantized, weight-dominated regimes. We release the evaluated corpus and anonymized framework to support replication.

summary.title_zh: 量化智能体剖析：代码合成智能体工作负载中的显存稳定性与预测
summary.tldr: 本文在单一框架（AgentK）、单一4比特权重量化方案（Q4_K_M）、单张H100 80GB GPU和四个LLM骨干上，对1920条代码合成智能体轨迹进行显存峰值测量。发现经实测校准的闭式解析模型在四个骨干中的三个上可与最佳学习型基线相当或更优，且峰值显存方差极低（变异系数0.3%–9.4%），说明在权重量化主导的显存格局下，复杂预测模型缺乏数据支撑。
summary.contributions: 第一，证明经实测校准的闭式解析模型（B5）在四个骨干中的三个上达到或超过最佳学习型回归基线（B2），测试MAPE为2.2%–4.4%对3.4%–6.5%，合并配对符号检验无显著差异（p=0.76）；第二，编译成功率严格按骨干能力分层（Phi-4-mini 5.7%、Mistral-7B 10.4%、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 36.7%、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 62.0%），说明功能代码合成受限于LLM内在能力而非可用显存；第三，峰值显存跨运行高度稳定（测试集变异系数0.3%–9.4%），4比特量化下静态权重占据绝大部分显存，基于提示特征的机器学习预测收益可忽略；第四，以Apache-2.0许可发布评估语料与匿名化AgentK参考框架。
summary.method: 论文构建闭式显存分解模型，将峰值显存拆为权重存储、KV缓存和激活开销三项，其中KV缓存按上下文长度、层数、头数、头维度和精度字节数计算。实验使用基于LangGraph的CUDA内核合成智能体AgentK，在单张NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU上运行四个Q4_K_M量化骨干（Phi-4-mini、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3），共1920条轨迹，覆盖300个提示（100个KernelBench提示、100个干净合成提示、100个诱发重试的合成提示），每500毫秒用pynvml采样显存。对比基线包括B0最坏情况闭式、B1提示长度回归、B2目标直接回归、B3每智能体常数均值、B5部分预言机馈入闭式。评估指标为MAPE、MAE、上界欠覆盖率、过度分配浪费，并做配对符号检验和自助法置信区间。
summary.results: 测试集上，B5在Mistral-7B（MAPE 4.44%对B2的6.52%）、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B（2.20%对3.43%）、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B（2.44%对4.41%）上优于B2，仅在Phi-4-mini上B2显著更优（0.24%对2.58%，p=9.3×10^-9）。合并270条测试行后B2与B5无显著差异（p=0.76）。若用原始GGUF文件大小替代实测权重显存并将激活开销设为零，MAPE飙升至16.66%–53.25%，欠覆盖率达100%。峰值显存测试集变异系数为0.32%–9.36%。编译成功率按骨干分层：Phi-4-mini 5.7%、Mistral-7B 10.4%、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 36.7%、Qwen2.5-Coder-14B 62.0%。方差分解显示提示家族和重试次数最多解释12.6%的方差，其余为残差噪声。数值正确性方面，149条编译成功轨迹全部在torch.allclose前失败，属测试工具限制而非模型数学错误。
summary.limitations: 仅评估Q4_K_M一种量化方案，未涉及Q8_0、FP16、AWQ或GPTQ等；分层划分的固定种子使测试切片偏向编译更容易的提示（如Qwen2.5-Coder-14B测试集编译成功率78.7%对全语料62.0%）；KernelBench数值正确性无法大规模测量，149条轨迹全部在数值检查前失败；闭式轨迹相关性在最终语料94%的轨迹上数学上无法定义；B5仅为部分预言机馈入，工具返回项设为零；权重与激活校准每个骨干仅依赖单次参考运行，无法给出这两个常数的统计置信区间。
summary.relevance: 论文直接研究大模型量化（Q4_K_M）下的显存行为，并聚焦长程Agent/多步工具调用场景（AgentK的CUDA内核合成智能体循环，含重试与工具调用）。与KV cache的关系明确：论文将KV缓存作为闭式显存分解的核心项之一，并实验扫描了n_ctx为8192/16384、KV缓存数据类型为f16/q8_0/q4_0的配置，发现配置扫描是唯一能解释大量峰值显存方差的因素（η²达0.913–1.000），而提示家族和重试次数解释力极弱。论文未进行Agent应用层面的实验，其结论限于显存预测与稳定性；对Agent调度、准入控制等应用属于推测性讨论，文中明确区分了统计欠覆盖率与物理OOM事件。

papers.title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents
papers.abstract: Memory is becoming core infrastructure for long-horizon LLM agents, yet existing evaluations offer limited guidance on which memory substrate, namely the underlying medium in which memory is represented and stored, should be used under different operating regimes. We present a controlled harness evaluation of memory substrates for memory-augmented agents, covering dense and sparse indices, text records, structural stores, hierarchical stores, refinement-based memories, parametric updates, and activation-compatible context mechanisms. Across three backbone models and four benchmark suites spanning user-centric question answering and agent-centric decision-making, we instrument 26 performance and efficiency metrics under a unified harness. Our results show that no single substrate consistently dominates: broad retrieval benefits long-context factual QA, while excessive retrieval can harm sequential decision-making by shifting attention away from action-critical context. Scalability introduces a further routing axis, as substrates that perform well at moderate history lengths can become costly or brittle at longer horizons. These findings motivate substrate routing as a necessary component of adaptive agent memory systems and provide empirical guidance for designing efficient, reliable, and regime-aware long-term memory for LLM agents. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

summary.title_zh: 驾驭记忆：记忆智能体中记忆基质的整体评估
summary.tldr: 该论文对记忆增强智能体中的记忆基质进行了受控的 harness 评估，覆盖 11 种方法、7 个基质家族、3 个骨干模型和 4 个基准，使用 26 个性能与效率指标。结果显示没有单一基质在所有场景中占优：结构图在对话问答中领先但在智能体任务中被帕累托支配，精炼记忆在具身规划中领先但在问答中落后；检索广度在长上下文问答中有利但在顺序决策中有害；可扩展性构成第三条路由轴。论文据此提出基质路由是自适应智能体记忆系统的必要组件。
summary.contributions: 论文声称的贡献包括：首次对智能体记忆进行整体 harness 评估，在外部与内部分类法的 11 种方法和 7 个基质家族、3 个骨干、4 个基准上隔离记忆基质，并使用 26 个指标使部署关键成本可见；首次跨用户中心与智能体中心任务的性能-延迟景观分析，识别哪些基质家族在何种操作机制下被支配，为多基质或多智能体记忆系统提供路由信号；对检索扩展和上下文可扩展性的诊断研究，包括检索深度扫描与注意力探测，以及各基质家族随输入增长的可扩展性分析。
summary.method: 论文采用受控 harness 评估，将记忆基质作为唯一实验变量，固定其余脚手架、骨干、提示和辅助 LLM 设置。基质分为外部记忆（M1 稠密向量、M2 稀疏向量、M3 要点索引、M4 演化笔记、M5 双层图、M6 层次树、M7 蒸馏策略、M8 技能包）和内部记忆（M9 适配器调优、M10 全上下文、M11 情节聚类重预填充）。骨干为 Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B-AWQ 和 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT，辅助 LLM 固定为 gpt-4o-mini。基准包括用户中心的 LoCoMo、MemoryAgentBench（含 LME-S、LRU、TTL、CR）和智能体中心的 ALFWorld、BigCodeBench-Hard。消融包括 top-k 检索广度扫描和 MAB CR 的上下文窗口压力测试。
summary.results: 在用户中心基准上，最佳基质随能力变化：LoCoMo 和 LME-S 上 M5 跨模型带表现最佳；MAB LRU 上 M10 在 Qwen3-8B 领先、M3 在 Qwen3-32B-AWQ 领先；MAB TTL 上 M3 和 M8 占优；MAB CR 上 M5 在三个模型中的两个领先。成本方面 M2 持续便宜，M5 可能慢 10 到 100 倍。在智能体中心基准上，ALFWorld 中 M11 在 Qwen3-8B 上将 NoMem 翻倍，M7 在 Qwen3-32B-AWQ 上达到最高 TSR 32.1%；BigCodeBench-Hard 中 M5 在 Qwen3-8B 和 Gemma-4 上领先（Pass@1 15.5% 和 20.9%），但 M5 的推理成本是扁平基质的 2 到 6 倍。检索深度扫描显示 LoCoMo 上 P4 随 k 单调上升，而 ALFWorld 上任务成功率随 k 下降（M7 从 k=1 的 32.1% 降至 k=5 的约 25%）。注意力探测显示检索广度增加会将注意力从任务上下文转移到检索块。可扩展性方面，M8 从 0.32 升至 0.51，M5 从 0.28 升至 0.48，但结构家族在 262K 时延迟急剧上升。
summary.limitations: 论文在附录 G 中列出局限性，包括排除了生产级系统，以及实现与参考论文存在偏差。此外，M7 仅适用于带轨迹的智能体中心任务，M9 与 Gemma-4-26B-A4B-IT 的 A4B MoE 路由不兼容，M10 因累积上下文超出测试上下文窗口而从两个智能体中心基准中省略。Zep、Mem0 和 MemGPT 因生产管线引入显著不同的辅助 LLM 预算而被排除在主受控比较之外。摘要未提供，需查看全文以获取更完整的局限性讨论。
summary.relevance: 该论文直接研究记忆基质，包括 KV cache 相关的激活家族（M10 全上下文、M11 情节聚类重预填充），并讨论 KV cache 作为内部记忆的权衡。对于大模型量化，论文未直接涉及量化方法，但其效率指标和性能-延迟分析可为量化部署中的记忆选择提供参考。对于长程 Agent 和多步工具调用量化，论文的智能体中心基准（ALFWorld、BigCodeBench-Hard）和检索广度反转发现直接相关：过度检索会损害顺序决策，这对多步工具调用中的记忆路由有启示。论文未进行量化实验，也未专门测试量化对记忆基质的影响；其 Agent 应用结论基于 ALFWorld 和 BigCodeBench-Hard 实验，而非工具调用量化实验。

papers.title: Training Leaves Traces: Centered Residual Signatures for Language Model Lineage Verification
papers.abstract: Open-weight language models are fine-tuned, quantized, pruned, and merged, yet their provenance is often undocumented. We study data-free white-box lineage verification: can weights alone reveal whether two compatible model checkpoints share ancestry? Residual training produces a shared identity-aligned component in branch products, so this structure alone cannot establish ancestry. We remove it and compare checkpoint-specific structure across residual blocks, yielding a symmetric lineage score calibrated against independent checkpoints. On residual-MLP and GPT-2 benchmarks, the score separates fine-tuned, LoRA-merged, pruned, and quantized descendants from independent and distilled models (AUROC=1.0), distinguishing weight ancestry from behavioral similarity. Under function-preserving checkpoint laundering experiments, weight-space baselines lose margin or fail; our score remains unchanged and runs 76x faster than the nearest robust baseline on GPT-2. The projection-pairing signal appears across six language-model families and beyond, and a case study correctly identifies 3 related and 7 unrelated LLaMA-2 public checkpoints. Collectively, these results establish a passive, data-free provenance signal for compatible open-weight language-model checkpoints

summary.title_zh: 训练留下痕迹：用于语言模型谱系验证的中心化残差签名
summary.tldr: 论文提出一种无需数据、白盒的模型谱系验证方法：利用残差块分支乘积中与恒等方向对齐的成分是通用的、无法区分血缘，因此剥离该成分，只比较每个残差块特有的无迹残差签名，并用独立训练模型校准阈值，从而判断两个兼容的残差架构检查点是否共享权重祖先。
summary.contributions: 1. 问题形式化：定义无数据的两两权重谱系验证任务，并提出中心化残差签名以分离检查点特有结构。2. 模型级分数：构建对称的模型级谱系分数，使用经验零分布校准，并对隐藏单元置换和互反缩放具有代数不变性。3. 稳健评估：测试对后训练变换、检查点洗白和蒸馏的稳健性，并在六个语言模型家族中展示投影配对恢复能力。
summary.method: 对残差块的分支乘积 M=W_K...W_1 做分解，拆成沿恒等方向的分量（系数为 tr(M)/d）与无迹余项 E。恒等分量是训练后普遍存在的通用结构，不能证明血缘；因此只保留无迹余项并归一化为签名 φ。对参考模型 A 与可疑模型 B 计算签名相似度矩阵，用匈牙利算法恢复块对应关系，再对对齐块求平均得到对称谱系分数 L(A,B)。用独立训练模型构成经验零分布，若 L 超过零分布最大值则判为 Related。方法要求白盒访问且架构兼容（相同层数与隐藏维度）。
summary.results: 在残差 MLP 与约 30M 参数 GPT-2 基准上，中心化残差签名将微调、LoRA 合并、剪枝、量化后代与独立训练及蒸馏模型分开，AUROC=1.0。MLP 基准 52 对（30 正、22 负），GPT-2 基准 45 对（21 正、24 负）。在函数保持的检查点洗白（置换、互反缩放）下，权重空间基线失去余量或失败，而本方法分数不变，在 GPT-2 上比最近的稳健基线快 76 倍。LLaMA-2 公开检查点案例中，3 个有文档后代得分 0.995、0.996、0.336，7 个独立模型得分绝对值小于 5e-5。投影配对信号在六个语言模型家族中出现，MLP 路径配对准确率 100%，随机初始化基线不超过 4%。蒸馏学生与教师行为相似但不产生血缘信号（L 约 0.002）。
summary.limitations: 需要两个检查点的白盒访问，仅适用于残差架构，且要求深度和隐藏维度匹配，不支持跨架构验证。分数是对称的，无外部元数据时无法判断谁是祖先；只比较单对，不重建多跳谱系或家族树。对部分继承（层嫁接、线性合并）只反映共享块比例，不指出哪些块被继承。变换越激进信号越弱：85% 稀疏度时 L=0.58，大量继续预训练（CodeLlama）降至 L=0.336。签名对 MLP 块内隐藏单元置换和互反缩放不变，但对残差流的正交旋转不变性不成立；对带学习型 LayerNorm/RMSNorm 参数的架构该旋转不是函数保持的。校准需要同架构独立训练模型，有效样本量受独立根数量限制（GPT-2 风格基准共 8 个根），其他架构家族测试不足。SwiGLU 架构块配对准确率仅 80%。
summary.relevance: 论文直接涉及量化：摘要与实验明确将量化后代（8-bit、INT8/INT6）作为血缘验证对象，报告量化后谱系分数仍接近 1（如 L≥0.996），说明量化不破坏该权重签名。论文未涉及长程 Agent 或多步工具调用量化，也没有任何 Agent 实验，因此与 Agent 场景的关系只能视为推测：若 Agent 使用量化后的开源权重模型，该方法或可用于追溯其权重来源，但论文未做此类验证。论文与 KV cache 无直接关系，未讨论 KV cache 量化或缓存结构；其分析对象是残差分支的权重乘积，而非推理时的激活或缓存。

papers.title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling
papers.abstract: Part-aware 3D object generation is essential for graphics applications such as controllable modeling, editing, and articulation, where objects are represented as coherent assemblies of semantic parts. However, existing part-aware generation methods, do not scale well to highly complex objects. As the number of parts increases, generating detailed geometry becomes prohibitively expensive in token length and memory. We introduce MegaParts, a scalable autoregressive 3D generation framework to address this challenge by combining structured sequence modeling with a token-efficient vector-quantized shape tokenizer. Our tokenizer learns discrete latent representations for part-level geometry by minimizing token usage subject to high-fidelity reconstruction, enabling adaptive-length tokenization based on geometric complexity. On top of this compact representation, we train a large language model to generate object bounding boxes, part bounding boxes, and part shape tokens within a unified structured sequence. Combined with efficient long-context training strategy, our token-efficient formulation scales to objects with up to 300 parts and sequence lengths up to 256k tokens. This substantially extends the scale of part-aware 3D generation while preserving compositional structure and enabling fine-grained part-level control. Our method achieves higher mesh quality than baseline autoregressive and diffusion models, showing that compressed discrete part tokens improve not only scalability but also the achievable fidelity of generated geometry. These results suggest that LLM native token-efficient autoregressive modeling is a compelling alternative to diffusion for large-scale part-aware 3D generation. The project page is available at https://expmaster.github.io/megaparts_webpage.

papers.title: p-Spin Glass Network Efficient Single-Batch Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Modern sequence models heavily rely on massive memory footprints and large-batch stochastic optimization, barriers that restrict sample efficiency and continual learning. We introduce the $p$-Spin Glass Network, a novel architecture that overcomes these limitations, structurally manages optimization variance and yields four noticeable capabilities: 1. It enforces memory efficiency: native ternary quantization compresses internal parameters by $8\times$, while exact implicit gradients strictly bound activation memory to $\mathcal{O}(B \cdot T \cdot D)$. 2. it demonstrates sample efficiency, matching the asymptotic performance of a Transformer baseline while utilizing $8\times$ fewer training sequences. 3. Method enables single-batch stability and smooth, monotonic convergence at a stochastic micro-batch size of $1$. 4. Finally, this stability proves modality-agnostic, maintaining robust temporal credit assignment across both discrete subword and long horizon uncompressed raw byte streams. Ultimately, this work removes large batch requirement for stable deep learning, establishing a foundation for continuous learning and edge AI.

papers.title: Beyond Capacity: Scalable MoE LLM Inference via High-Bandwidth Flash with Direct GPU and HBM Paths
papers.abstract: Modern mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models increasingly strain the capacity and cost efficiency of high-bandwidth memory (HBM), as rapidly growing expert weights must be provisioned close to GPUs. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers substantially greater capacity, but conventional designs typically deliver HBF-resident expert weights to the GPU through HBM, leaving an additional direct GPU-HBF connection underutilized. We explore an HBF organization that simultaneously exploits two independent expert-delivery routes: a direct path that transfers expert weights from HBF to the GPU and a relay path that transfers them from HBF through the HBM base die to the GPU. Whole experts are assigned to one of the two routes, and transfers over both routes proceed concurrently, increasing aggregate expert-delivery bandwidth without replicating expert weights or introducing a shared relay bottleneck. Early expert determination identifies upcoming experts ahead of their conventional execution point, allowing HBF read latency to overlap with preceding computation, while separate management of immutable expert weights and mutable KV-cache data reduces interference between the two traffic classes. We evaluate the architecture using an event-driven continuous-batching LLM serving simulator with empirically measured GPU compute latencies. Across representative MoE workloads, concurrently utilizing the direct GPU-HBF and HBF-HBM-GPU routes consistently improves expert-delivery efficiency over designs restricted to either route alone. For a representative workload, the proposed architecture can achieve 1.94$\times$ higher throughput and 1.90$\times$ end-to-end speedup over a design that delivers all HBF-resident expert weights to the GPU through the HBM base die.

papers.title: Personalized Digital Semantic Communication for Image Transmission with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Semantic communication (SC) enables bandwidth-efficient wireless image transmission, but most existing SC schemes are user-agnostic and ignore receiver-dependent semantics. To address this issue, we propose a personalized digital semantic communication (PDSC) framework that integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-based semantic encoder with a latent diffusion model (LDM)-based semantic decoder. Specifically, the semantic encoder extracts source-aware personalized semantic tokens from both the source image and the receiver's historical interactions. These tokens are vector-quantized into discrete semantic indices and further encoded into a compact fixed-length bitstream, enabling compatibility with digital transmission. At the receiver, the semantic decoder reconstructs a personalized image conditioned on the recovered semantic tokens. Furthermore, we formulate a capacity-constrained personalized semantic rate-distortion problem and introduce a semantic distortion metric that jointly characterizes source-semantic fidelity and user-preference alignment. Experiments show that PDSC achieves superior source-semantic consistency and personalization over state-of-the-art SC baselines, including CDDM and MoS, under bandwidth-limited wireless transmission.

papers.title: Towards Efficient Multimodal and Multilingual Opinion Extraction for STI: A QLoRA-Based Fine-Tuning Approach
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have reshaped semantic analysis. Opinion Extraction (OE) for Science and Technology Intelligence (STI) requires concise core opinions from large information streams. Off-the-shelf models struggle to filter noise from these streams and show limited structured-output reliability in zero-shot multilingual and multi-modal settings. To address information overload and extraction defocus, this study proposes a multimodal core-opinion extraction framework in which visual evidence serves as a contextual anchor for textual judgment. Using VideoLLaMA2 (VL2) and VideoLLaMA2.1 (VL2.1) as the base models, we apply Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) fine-tuning on a curated dataset of 2,194 multilingual and multimodal samples. Under the selected Image-Augmented setting, fine-tuned VL2.1 generates structured JSON core-opinion outputs, achieving 64.98% Precision, 42.15% Recall, 51.14% F1-score, and 74.00% sample-level accuracy. Relative to the zero-shot VL2.1 setting, it raises the F1-scores of Spanish and Russian from 4.83% and 0.45% to 46.05% and 51.93%, respectively. The framework further incorporates a Fuzzy Cumulative Prospect Theory-based post-extraction triage module for case-level value assessment, providing a case-level value signal for downstream STI screening.

papers.title: Content Based Video Narration of Gameplay with Vision Language Models
papers.abstract: Live game commentary is scarce: it exists for professional esports broadcasts and almost nowhere else. We present a content-based video narration system that produces spoken, esports-style commentary for arbitrary gameplay recordings using a general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) and a text-to-speech back end, with no game-specific instrumentation, no engine telemetry, and no task-specific training. Three mechanisms carry the system. Temporal mosaic packing arranges nine uniformly sampled frames into a single 3x3 image, letting an image-native VLM reason about motion while consuming one image payload per segment instead of nine. Context-conditioned prompting replays the K most recent narrations as assistant-role history, suppressing the repetition that dominates per-segment captioning of static scenes. Duration-conditioned generation and elastic alignment constrain narration length in the prompt, then time-scale or symmetrically pad the synthesized audio so each utterance fills its segment slot exactly, giving frame-accurate muxing without a forced aligner. The implementation supports either cloud TTS or a 6-bit quantized 4B-parameter on-device TTS model on Apple silicon, making the speech stage fully local. We report a qualitative case study on real-time strategy footage, a cost model showing the mosaic reduces per-minute image payloads by 9x, and a candid account of observed failure modes - hallucinated game state, resolution loss from mosaicking, and prosody artifacts from time-scaling. We release the system as a reproducible baseline, with an evaluation protocol for the quantitative study a full version will report.

papers.title: QUASAR: Lowering the Loss Floor of Quantization-Aware Training with Loss-Aware Reconstruction
papers.abstract: As large language model inference shifts toward lower precision, post-training quantization (PTQ) becomes increasingly brittle, making quantization-aware training (QAT) essential for preserving model quality. However, QAT computes the loss and surrogate gradients using a lossy reconstruction of latent full-precision weights, while applying updates to the latent weights themselves. This mismatch can lead to suboptimal training trajectories and a higher loss floor. Second-order PTQ methods mitigate a similar gap by minimizing loss-aware reconstruction error, but doing it once for a frozen model can take hours; repeating this process throughout QAT as the weights evolve is impractical. We introduce QUASAR, a QAT method that continuously performs lightweight, loss-aware reconstruction in the training loop to lower the loss floor and improve the resulting low-bit model. At each training step, QUASAR uses the exponential moving average of squared gradients as online saliency estimates, searches over a small set of clipping ranges, and fits affine dequantizers via saliency-weighted least squares. Our analysis shows that the loss-aware reconstruction error is the only reconstruction-dependent term in the QAT convergence bound and controls the loss of the final quantized model, establishing QUASAR's objective as a principled optimization target. QUASAR modifies only the training procedure and supports standard deployment formats, including integer quantization and NVFP4, with no inference-time changes or overhead. Across Qwen3 and Llama-3.1, QUASAR achieves the lowest held-out KL divergence among competitive QAT methods at 2, 3, and 4 bits, reducing KL by at least 10% at 3 and 4 bits and by 29% at 2 bits. At 2 bits, it improves average accuracy across eight tasks by 3.5-4.3 percentage points over strong QAT and PTQ baselines.

papers.title: VoiceChat-TTS: A Low-Latency Continuous Speech Synthesis Model for Interactive Agents
papers.abstract: Spoken dialogue is a natural form of human--computer interaction, yet most speech language models remain limited to turn-based operation and lack real-time adaptability, such as user barge-in. Recent duplex speech-to-speech and speech-to-text models reduce latency by replacing multi-stage pipelines, but often compromise speech quality because accurate ASR, interruption handling, and high-fidelity synthesis must be optimized jointly. We propose VoiceChat-TTS, a low-latency, continuous, and streamable text-to-speech model for interactive agents. VoiceChat-TTS is driven directly by LLM text-token streams, supports explicit interruption via control tokens, and produces silence when no textual input is available. The model enables always-on, responsive speech generation while preserving modularity and high speech quality, and it supports mid-utterance interruptions without resetting the KV cache.

papers.title: YAVIN: A Unified Architecture for Secure Edge Processing in Memory
papers.abstract: Secure, private multi-tenant execution spanning processors, memory, and accelerators remains one of the most significant challenges in modern edge computing systems. Simultaneously, processing-in-memory (PIM) has emerged as an effective approach for reducing the Von Neumann bottleneck by moving computation closer to data. Existing trusted execution environments (TEEs) establish trust only within the processor, protecting data while it traverses untrusted resources such as the memory bus. Consequently, trusted computation cannot be performed directly within memory. We present YAVIN, a unified trusted computing base (TCB) that extends the TEE beyond the processor to encompass both processor execution and a dedicated memory region supporting trusted processing-in-memory execution while treating the memory bus as untrusted. Leveraging the dedicated protected memory regions already established by conventional TEE architectures, YAVIN enables data to be decrypted, processed, and re-encrypted by either processor or PIM execution while remaining within the TEE. To realize this unified TCB, YAVIN presents the first PIM implementations of the LightSaber KEM post-quantum cryptosystem and ASCON-128 authenticated encryption, co-designing both algorithms for efficient DRAM execution to establish and maintain shared cryptographic state. Finally, we demonstrate how cryptography-PIM co-design for tensor-based workloads reorganizes computation to satisfy the ordering constraints imposed by authenticated encryption with minimal performance overhead while simultaneously enabling bit-sliced ordering that limits temporary plaintext exposure. Compared to the latest PIM AES implementation, YAVIN achieves more than a 20x speedup while incurring only 34% and 9.3% overhead when executing INT8 and INT32 quantized edge-class LLMs, respectively, relative to plaintext execution.

papers.title: RippleMem: From Isolated Retrieval to Associative Recollection for Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on external memory to support long-horizon reasoning and interaction. However, the main bottleneck is not simply storing past experience, but recovering the right set of evidence when relevant information is distributed across many interactions. Existing approaches struggle with this access problem. Full-context methods require noisy long-context search, flat retrieval often returns isolated and incomplete records, and graph-based memory systems can be expensive to construct while compressing rich event context. We introduce RippleMem, a long-term memory system that replaces one-shot retrieval with adaptive associative recollection. Inspired by cue-dependent episodic retrieval and associative completion, RippleMem stores interaction history as cue-rich episodic memory units and organizes them in an event-centric memory graph. Given a query, it first recalls relevant memory anchors through hybrid cues, then expands from these anchors along semantic and structural associations to recover missing supporting evidence. In this way, initially recalled memories serve not only as answer context, but also as cues for completing the evidence needed to answer. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show that RippleMem achieves the best overall performance across evaluated settings, improving LLM-as-a-Judge accuracy by 3.95% on LoCoMo and up to 11.87% on LongMemEval-S, while reducing graph construction cost by about 30x.

papers.title: EgoCITE: Context-Augmented Indexing and Time-Aware Retrieval for Long-Horizon Egocentric Memory
papers.abstract: Long-horizon egocentric memory transforms continuous first-person video and audio into a searchable record of past experiences. We demonstrate two bottlenecks in existing systems: indices built from context-poor captions are unreliable for agentic search, while retrieval ignores a question's temporal intent. To address both bottlenecks, we introduce EgoCITE (Egocentric Context-augmented Indexing and Time-aware Evidence retrieval), a long-horizon agentic memory framework for egocentric QA. EgoCITE comprises three components. EgoScheme uses local multimodal context to turn fragmentary video captions and speech transcripts into self-contained atomic memory indices. EgoIndex organizes complementary action, activity, utterance, and conversation representations into searchable multi-view memory indices at multiple granularities. EgoRetrv combines semantic search with question-conditioned temporal relevance scoring and curation of retrieved evidence. We evaluate EgoCITE on EgoLifeQA, EgoMem, and EgoR1-Bench in terms of answer accuracy and target-event retrieval alignment. EgoCITE improves accuracy over agentic memory baselines by at least 4.4--14.2% while achieving 36$\times$ lower cost than long-context LLM agents.

papers.title: RT-SEMamba: Real-Time Speech Enhancement Mamba via Progressive Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract: We present RT-SEMamba, a fully causal speech enhancement (SE) model built upon causal time-frequency Mamba blocks. Unlike Transformer-based architectures that rely on a growing key-value cache, Mamba propagates a fixed-size recurrent state per layer, enabling memory- and bandwidth-efficient long-form inference. We further introduce a progressive knowledge distillation (KD) strategy that compresses an 8-layer teacher into a shallow 1-layer student by jointly distilling complex spectral outputs and intermediate representations. On Voicebank-DEMAND, the 8-layer RT-SEMamba achieves 3.32 PESQ with a 25 ms algorithmic latency constraint, and the distilled 1-layer student improves over a naive 1-layer baseline from 3.06 to 3.18 PESQ while preserving the same steady-state RTF, delivering a 2.75x speedup over the teacher. These results demonstrate that state-space models with progressive KD provide a competitive quality-latency trade-off for real-time SE.

papers.title: MARCH: Scaling Recurrent Memory with Content-Routed State Anchors
papers.abstract: Transformers owe much of their strong long-context retrieval capability to a token-level memory that grows with context length. This flexibility, however, incurs a quadratic computation complexity during training and a key--value cache that grows linearly during autoregressive inference. Recurrent alternatives offer efficient decoding by compressing the entire history into a fixed-size state, but often underperform on recall-intensive tasks since earlier associations usually get overwritten by subsequent updates, and only the most recent contextual information is retained. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Anchor Routing across Context History (MARCH), a network architecture that effectively scales state-space models beyond a fixed-size dimension, while maintaining computational efficiency over long-sequences. MARCH periodically caches cumulative recurrent-state checkpoints as state anchors and associates each anchor with a compact, content-conditioned anchor key. This lets MARCH maintain a memory bank, which can grow as context length increases, providing a controllable trade-off between historical resolution and memory cost. At each token, MARCH produces an anchor query to attend all causally available state anchors, and the output is calculated as an attention-style aggregation over all historical anchors along the current state. We show that after standard pretraining, MARCH consistently outperforms multiple linear attention variants across commonsense reasoning, LongBench, and in-context retrieval. These results demonstrate that content-routed state caching substantially strengthens recurrent long-range memory while preserving its native computation path.

papers.title: SoftWater: Class-Aware Rate Allocation for Softmax Quantization
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization pipelines routinely leave the softmax output layer in high precision. Yet in small LLMs with modern vocabularies, the head holds 15--30\% of all parameters, so a nominal ``2-bit'' model with an fp16 head can store several times as many bits per weight. We pose softmax-layer quantization as a rate-distortion problem under the KL divergence between the original and quantized output distributions. A second-order analysis reveals a class-aware geometry: quantization error is weighted jointly by feature covariance and class-specific softmax curvature. A separability approximation replaces the $Kn\times Kn$ Cholesky with one $n\times n$ factorization rescaled per class, making the lattice encodable by successive interference cancellation, with both statistics from a single forward pass. The resulting method, SoftWater, gives fine grids to frequent, low-variance classes and coarse grids to rare ones, a large gap under Zipfian token distributions. Across five models from 1B to 32B, SoftWater outperforms the released WaterSIC quantizer (near-optimal under linear-layer WMSE but not output KL) at matched head rates on 59 of 60 test points, using none of that pipeline's refinements and cutting head-induced KL by $6.5\times$--$8.3\times$ at 2 bits. On Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct with quantized bodies, a 2-bit head removes 45--60\% of stored bytes for a $2.9$--$3.7\%$ perplexity increase. Because the class-side statistic comes from calibration data, matching calibration to the deployment domain gives the lowest KL on that domain throughout. On a tied model, a 4-bit head is near-lossless and a 2-bit head costs under 4\% perplexity, making head quantization of such models practical.

papers.title: Unified Multi-Dialectal Neural Machine Translation for Bangla Using the Dwadash Benchmark Corpus
papers.abstract: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at cross-lingual tasks but often fail to capture intra-lingual morphological variation, marginalizing dialectal speakers. In Bangla, existing translation frameworks commonly rely on Standard Colloquial Bangla (SCB) as an intermediate pivot, which can compound errors and reduce cross-dialectal nuance. To address this gap, we introduce a unified, multi-directional NMT system for direct translation between SCB and eleven regional variants. We first review prior dialectal NLP resources to identify existing technological gaps. As a foundational contribution, we construct and release a large multi-dialect parallel corpus for Bangla, comprising 14,562 aligned rows and 51,541 non-null sentence pairs through the integration of seven prior datasets and native-speaker-verified manual augmentation. Using this corpus, we benchmark state-of-the-art sequence-to-sequence architectures with parameter-efficient Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation (DoRA). Results show that deep monolingual pre-training is more effective than large multilingual capacity for this task. The compact BanglaT5 model outperforms NLLB-200 and mBART-50 by up to 13.96 BLEU, achieving 29.26 BLEU, 57.26 chrF++, and 49.68 METEOR. A dataset scaling study shows diminishing returns beyond 3,000 parallel pairs and indicates that linguistic proximity to Standard Bangla is more important than raw data volume for translation quality. Finally, we deploy the optimized model as an INT8-quantized web application, providing a scalable, open-source framework for inclusive language technology and equitable digital access.

papers.title: Benchmarking Trustworthiness of SLMs: Pre-trained vs. Compressed
papers.abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) have emerged as a more efficient alternative to traditional Large Language Models (LLMs), offering promising potential in resource-constrained scenarios.
